GLA University Mathura UP popular programmes are BTech and MBA. BTech and MBA students are placed in various companies such as Adani Group, Wipro, Accenture, Microsoft, Capgemini, and others. BTech students can work as Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Civil Engineers, and Electronics Engineers, or can take up various job opportunities relevant to their field.

placements.overview:
The GLA University Mathura full form stands for Ganeshi Lal Agrawal University and was founded in 2010 as a private university. It has been accredited by NAAC with an grade A+ and recognised by the UGC and AICTE. Located in Mathura, GLA Mathura, through 14 departments and 9 institutes, offers 250+ courses at the UG, PG, Doctoral and Diploma levels to students. These courses are provided for Engineering, Chemistry, and various others. Moroever, it also offers distance education to students through the Centre for Distance and Online Education.

GLA University Mathura UP popular programmes are BTech and MBA. BTech and MBA students are placed in various companies such as Adani Group, Wipro, Accenture, Microsoft, Capgemini, and others. BTech students can work as Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Civil Engineers, and Electronics Engineers, or can take up various job opportunities relevant to their field.

faqs.answer: A:    GLA University offers four-year courses of BTech and BTech (Hons). For admission to BTech course at GLA University, the minimum eligibility is to pass Class 12 with Physics & Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry/ Computer Science with an aggregate of 50% (45% aggregate for SC/ ST) in the above subjects taken together and 50% aggregate overall. Apart from this, to get admission to BTech (Hons), students need to pass Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics as main subjects along with Chemistry/ Computer Science as additional subjects with a minimum of 65% aggregate and 70% aggregate as overall.

GLA University Mathura admissions 2025 are both merit and entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process. Find below the detailed process around GLA admissions 2025:
Step 1: GLA University Mathura Application Process 2025

GLA University Mathura admission process 2025 starts with the application process. Candidates can download the application process from the university's official website. The duly filled application form has to be sent either through post or submitted in person at the concerned department at GLA University Mathura. However, the application and entrance test fee will be paid online and candidates have to attach the pay slip along with the two copies of the online bank challan with the application form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to all the PG courses at GLA University Mathura is entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for either university-level or state-level entrance exams such as GLAET for the selection of respective courses. Furthermore, the university offers UG courses through its affiliated colleges. Admissions to UG courses are based on merit scores obtained in the last qualifying exam.
Step 3: Merit List Release & Counselling

After the completion of all the selection rounds, candidates have to appear for the counselling process for the respective courses. Later on, the university will release the merit list in various rounds of the selected candidates. Students who find their names on the merit list need to pay a certain amount ofGLA University Mathura feeto secure their seat.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in GLA University for MBA?
faqs.answer: The universityMBAapplication process is both online and offline. Candidates can either visit the official website to apply. For offline mode, download the application form through the official website of the university and submit it to the admission office along with the required documents. reviews.review_heading: Genuine review from GLA University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are smart and modern. There is world-class infrastructure in our college. Hostel, food, and rest are all average to decent category. Medical facility is available in the college. Sports and games activity is available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the staff and management.
reviews.review_text: Overall, the infrastructure of the college is very good. All labs are equipped with separate Wi-Fi and a firewall to prevent misuse of Wi-Fi. The speed of Wi-Fi is very good. Facilities in the hostel are also very good. The food is given properly, and the health of students is taken care of very responsibly.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GLA University.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good infrastructure. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with projectors and Wi-Fi. Mess food quality is manageable but repetitive, and hygiene is mostly maintained. A medical facility is also available. The central library is well-maintained with a large number of books, journals and digital resources. Hostel facilities are average to good, with clean rooms and basic needs.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning experience with an active campus.
reviews.review_text: The facilities for my course are good. Classrooms are clean and comfortable. Labs are useful for practical work and help us understand subjects better. Wi-Fi is available on campus, and the library has enough books and study material for students. Hostel facilities are okay and suitable for students. Rooms are decent and livable. Mess food is average but clean, and the canteen has different food items. Medical help is available on campus when needed. The college also has good sports facilities f...

reviews.review_heading: GLA University Mathura is a private university. It has many courses, like engineering.
reviews.review_text: GLA University Mathura has good infrastructure with campus Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, and a spacious library. Hostels are decent and clean, the mess food is average while medical and sports facilities are easily available and well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, good placements, good infrastructure, and not-so-good facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are fairly good. Every department has its own Wi-Fi, and classrooms are also really well made. Each class has projectors and enough space. The library is also really well made and a nice place to study quietly and peacefully. Talking about the hostel, it also depends on one's adjustment qualities. But the food in the mess is good and sometimes not good too. Canteen food is better tasting than the mess hall food. Medical facilities are average. There is room for impr...

reviews.review_heading: Review of GLA University.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course. They provide us with 24/7 facilities, a modern classroom with a digital board and a projector. Computer labs were working generally. Hostel quality was good. All essential amenities are available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placements with good infrastructure, but students must build skills.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is quite good and well maintained. Classrooms are spacious, properly ventilated, and equipped with projectors. Labs for our course are decent with sufficient systems. Wi-Fi is available across the campus and hostels, but the speed may vary at times. The library is large and peaceful. There are two libraries on the campus: one central and one basic. Hostel facilities are satisfactory, with clean rooms and proper security. Mess food quality is average but manageab...

reviews.review_heading: GLA University is good for placements and overall personality growth.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The library, labs, and classrooms are fully air-conditioned and well-maintained. Wi-Fi speed on the campus is good. Canteens are hygienic and have a good menu at a good price. Medical facilities are pretty good. There is an ambulance service 24x7. Food in the mess of hostels is good and hygienic. GLA has many football courts, basketball courts, and a cricket ground. Students are encouraged to play sports by the department.

reviews.review_heading: Crowd with the aims and achievements.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members are good at college, provide detailed information about the syllabus and provide content to explore more about the practical implementation, hostels are good in infrastructure and canteens are too good, like malls, you can shop via card.

reviews.review_heading: A good college in terms of fest, events, and college life.
reviews.review_text: In my ECE department, there is hardly any lab missing. Every machine required in our course is present on our campus. Many of my friends live in the hostel, the hostel room quality is very good, but the mess food is below average, and also canteen food is not so good as per the price. Sports facilities are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Good if you want to explore yourself.
reviews.review_text: They are equipped with Wi-Fi, smart board, and electronics labs for practical experience of the theory they are teaching, and hostels have separate ones for first year and for all years, and the menu in all messes is the same, but messes for all hostels are different, and they also have wings.

reviews.review_heading: College has all the facilities, and also the faculty is very helpful.
reviews.review_text: Every department has its own classrooms and labs. Wi-Fi is provided throughout the college campus. Food quality in the canteen is also average. Medical facilities are provided. Sports facilities like basketball court and ground are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: College is awesome. It has a good placement ratio even in the COVID-19 pandemic.
reviews.review_text: Our college has the best infrastructure. It has high internet connectivity. Classrooms are neat and clean. The quality of food is awesome, and it has many different options. There is a clinic in college. There are good playgrounds for playing cricket, athletic games, and basketball. It also has a good sports trainer.

reviews.review_heading: Don't take admission in GLA University.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are okay, but the academic infrastructure is not good. Classes are old, facilities are not up to the mark, and hostel timings are very bad, specifically for girls. Classes get over at 6 pm, and girls' hostel timing is 6:30 pm, while boys' hostel timing is 8 pm. You can't leave the campus after 8, and you can't take parcels and food orders after 10 pm. There are no sports facilities and no extracurricular activities.

faqs.answer: Cracking JEE Mains in six months for GL Bajaj Noida Technology and Management BTech admission depends on candidates' preparation and a well-structured study plan. Cutoffs for BTech courses at GL Bajaj Noida on the basis of ranks secured in JEE Mains are not so competitive. college_info.intro:
The flagship programmes extended at GL Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management Greater Noida include BTech, MBA and MCA. For BTech, selection is based on the merit of Class 12 + UPCET /JEE Main score. On the other hand, for MBA, students must have a bachelors degree in the respective field. In addition to this, students must appear for UPCET/ CAT/ MAT scores.
The GL Bajaj Noida fee structure for BTech has a total tuition fee of INR 2.45 Lakhs while the GL Bajaj Noida MBA fees stands at INR 1.33 Lakhs and the GL Bajaj Noida MCA fees is at INR 1.22 Lakhs.

admission_process.title: GL Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: 1. GL Bajaj Application Process 2026

Candidates need to apply offline. Students can download the application form from the official website. After filling it, the form must be sent via post or submitted in person at the concerned department. The application and entrance test fee are paid online, with candidates attaching the pay slip and online bank challan copies with the form.
2. Selection Rounds
Admissions are based on entrance exams such as UPCET/CAT/MAT/GATE for the BTech, MBA, MCA, and MTech courses at GL Bajaj. For example, BTech admissions are based on Class 12 and UPCET/JEE Main score.
3. Merit List Release & Counselling

Following the selection rounds, candidates undergo counselling for their respective courses. Subsequently, GL Bajaj releases merit lists in various rounds for selected candidates. Those on the list must pay a specified fee to secure their seats.
For GL Bajaj admissions, candidates can either apply through the UPSEE counselling process or opt for direct admission via the institute's website.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied because, according to my JEE Main marks, I am eligible for a better college.
reviews.review_text: For our course CSE, college infrastructure is not that much good. Our classes are old and AC is not there yet, but they assure us to put AC next year. I do not live in the hostel, but according to my friends, hostel fees for 1 year is about 130,000, which is too high.

reviews.review_heading: G.L. Bajaj College is the best in academics.
reviews.review_text: There are good facilities for sports. The hostel is nice for first-year students. The canteen is good to serve variety of food. Sports are good in college. There are various types of sports like football and cricket. There is a good library in college to learn various kinds of departments. In-campus hostel facilities are also nice. Food quality is not comparable to home food, but still edible and better than other colleges in the locality.

reviews.review_heading: My college provides the best placement.
reviews.review_text: My college provides a simple and decent campus that lacks the amenities of a more modern facility. However, the good placement opportunities at GL Bajaj more than make up for it. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, but classrooms are not air-conditioned. GL Bajaj excels in sports, with its football and kabaddi teams consistently winning zonal competitions.

reviews.review_heading: My college is good as it has good infrastructure and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is so good. There is a library that is open 24x7. Labs have proper working machines and equipment. Classrooms have fans and proper seating arrangements. The hostel facilities are also good, as it has a playground for sports. We get good quality food. It has a neat and clean mess. The hostel also provides medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The campus facilities are okay. Placements depend a lot on your skills and involvement.
reviews.review_text: In our college infrastructure is really good. We have a library which is open 18 hours a day including Sunday and all weekends. The Wi-Fi facilities are also provided. Every year a sports meet is also organised by the college in which all students have a chance to participate.

reviews.review_heading: I mean to say this is a very nice college where everyone enjoys their course with lots of fun.
reviews.review_text: Here is free Wi-Fi, labs with helpful instructors, and a library with a large collection of books. In the hostel, single, double, and triple sharing rooms are available. Good food is provided by the canteen. There is also a big playground for sports like cricket, badminton, and volleyball.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement is in 3 years in Greater Noida.
reviews.review_text: Quality of hostel food is good, and not something like very good but girls hostel food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good in terms of hard work and placement.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is provided for all the students in the college. Fully AC labs for students are available. The library also consists of AC. Hostel facilities are quite good. It offers good food in the canteen. Grounds are also provided to hostel students.

reviews.review_heading: My college is the best in academics.

reviews.review_heading: GRIET tops in placements, strong faculty, and vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: GRIET offers good infrastructure with smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, campus-wide Wi-Fi, and a spacious digital library. There is no boys' hostel. Canteen food is average, medical facilities are basic, and sports facilities are decent.

reviews.review_heading: There are some drawbacks, but good to survive.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library are available for our branch. Other infrastructures are also available for our particular course. Hostel facilities are provided only for girls in our college, and that too only up to a limited capacity. There is no college hostel or PG for boys. There is a hall for indoor games and sports and a sufficiently large ground to play outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the placements in the year 2025. Many students got placed with a good package.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi connection is poor and the canteen is very small. There is no college hostel for boys and no court for badminton or kabaddi. The indoor games are very few, and the quality of food in the canteen is average. .The infrastructure of the 1st year 3rd block was very poor.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, infrastructure, but the course curriculum is not industry oriented.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure was also very good, neat and beautiful. In our department labs were very well structured with all the required facilities. Wi-Fi facility was also available in labs. The library was there with good sources for learning. The sports facility was good. The canteen was available. There was no hostel for boys in college.

reviews.review_heading: Better college for placements.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are neat, there is only one girls hostel with limited seats so one has to be quick enough to grab it if looking for college hostels. There are many hostels surrounding the college. The library is good but students are not always allowed during the classes.

reviews.review_heading: Outdated syllabus and faculty but placements are really good.
reviews.review_text: Library is pretty good, but labs and Wi-Fi facilities are not so good. Students are not allowed in the library during classes. Laptops are pretty old in the labs and the course syllabus is pretty outdated. It is better not to jump into arguments with the lab faculty.

reviews.review_heading: One can study here for four years, but the experience is not as good as at IITs or NITs.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure availability for my course/department are good or above average. The hostel facility in the college is only for girls, and it has a decent and limited capacity. Finally, the facilities or freedom for mess, canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games are average, with some small and silly rules.

reviews.review_heading: GRIET is an excellent campus which provides good knowledge and modern skills.
reviews.review_text: GRIET has good infrastructure and facilities, including a library, laptops, labs, and large classrooms. Good-tasting food is available in the canteen, and medical emergencies are handled with a qualified doctor available during college hours. Sports and games competitions are also held for students.

reviews.review_heading: Good in all aspects for sure.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure was good enough. We have different blocks for different departments. We have a library, nice classrooms, and labs too. But we do not have a hostel facility in our college. However, we have a canteen where the food is very nice and the prices are affordable.

reviews.review_heading: GREET the college of excellence.
reviews.review_text: Gokaraju Rangaraju Institute of Engineering and Technology is good at sports. They conduct sports meets every year, encourage each and every department in sports and a PT period is also available for each department.

reviews.review_heading: GRIET is absolutely satisfied with our faculty and curriculum.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is beautiful and its a green campus. Wherever you see. You find trees, and when it comes to labs, there are less laptops and most of them wont work properly. The canteen food is not that hygienic but worth that price.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, nice facilities, a canteen, a library, etc. It is a good college.
reviews.review_text: There are good facilities and infrastructure in our college. Mostly, Wi-Fi connections have a considerably good speed. In labs, laptops are used, and they are slower than an average laptop. Classrooms are vast, clean, and peaceful. We have a large library for reading with good maintenance. Referenced books for semester preparation are available there. Record books are also sold here. There is no hostel for boys in this college. Clean and good-quality food is available in the canteen. There are n...

reviews.review_heading: I was fairly satisfied with the education, though the facilities were not up to expectations.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, but I am a little disappointed with basic facilities such as washrooms. It would be better if they were improved for better comfort and hygiene. Regarding the canteen, it doesn't meet our expectations. Even though the college infrastructure is good, the way to college is in bad condition.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty behaviour is very bad, but placements are good, and the library is large.
reviews.review_text: The college has considerably fast Wi-Fi connection, though some labs have very slow laptops. Classrooms are vast, clean, and peaceful. The infrastructure is excellent, neat, and calm. There is no hostel, but canteen food is good. There are a few indoor and outdoor games and limited medical facilities. The library is very good and large.

reviews.review_heading: Should not expect more about the fests, mainly the college focuses on the training and placement.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for my department are good. For the lab, they provide laptops. Every student gets a laptop. There are up to 50-60 laptops in a lab. The food provided by the mess and canteen is okay, and they provide a gym and sports.

college_info.intro:
Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya offers numerous UG, PG, and Doctoral courses across streams such as Engineering, Humanities, Science, Commerce, Law, Education, Medicine and Health Sciences, etc. The popular courses at GGV Bilaspur include MSc and MA. The courses are offered in full-time mode.
MA graduates from GGV are acquainted with skills such as social, economic, political, historical, philosophical, and ideological. The course provides an understanding and importance of literature, and promotes the moral, mental, and intellectual development of the students. The MA programme provides an understanding of the influence of literature on society. MA graduates from GGV can opt for government and civil services.
MSc at Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya Bilaspur provides students with the fundamental knowledge of subjects such as Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Botany, Zoology, Microbiology, etc. The MSc programme also assists students in developing analytical skills to critically analyse scientific and critical data to pursue higher studies. MSc graduates from GGV can also pursue careers such as Software Developer, Web Developer, Data Scientist, Lecturer, Research Scientist, etc. Further, MSc graduates can also prepare for government and competitive exams.

review_summary.college_name: Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: Average college for students of law. Teachers are very good, and the college infrastructure is good.

content.Placements: Not that many placements were provided. I think 40% of students are getting placements in this college, Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya. Almost 50% of students secure internships during their B.A. studies. LL.B. from this college. The highest package is 8 LPA, and the lowest package is 2.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are law firms. Local top roles offer me the opportunity to communicate with a wide range of people.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure of our B.A. The LL.B. law department is very nice and well-settled. All books are available in the law department library. We didn't face any problems there. The Wi-Fi also works very well. The hostel is very good for accommodation. The food is also very good and edible. The cafeteria, medical facilities, and sports games are also very good. Games are played on their scheduled time.

individual_reviews.course: Masters of Social Work - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Very unique chance to get.

content.Placements: Placements are very average in this course. For this course mostly students are placed in different health care. In the government sector, there are very few jobs. Students are placed as nutritionists, mental health advisors, child welfare specialists, etc. In India, there is less scope, but in foreign countries, there is a very good scope.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. There are different grounds for different sports. The library is good. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. There are different canteens inside the college. In college, there is first aid medical present.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Political Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely good college for this course.

content.Placements: For this course, placements are very low. Students mostly get jobs in different colleges and universities as assistant professors. Some students opted for Ph.D. For internship, there is a 6-month compulsory internship in government colleges as guest lecturer.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. Labs are spacious. Classrooms are good and digitally updated. Hostels are 2-seated or 3-seated rooms. Mess food is average. Library is good but has timings. There are different indoor and outdoor grounds for different sports.

individual_reviews.course: M. Pharm. (Pharmacology) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A very good government college is less expensive.

content.Placements: Placements are very average. Students are placed through referral from the teachers and seniors. Students are placed in different sectors like pharmacovigilance, clinical trials, Medical coding, etc. Salaries given mostly range between 30k and 35k per month. Cipla and Sunpharma are the top recruiters.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available all over the campus, and CCTV security is in place. There are many hostels inside the campus. Classrooms are spacious and have all the facilities like projectors and smartboards. Labs are spacious and have all the apparatus used in industry. There are many cafeteria restaurants inside the campus. There are many grounds for different sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: According to me, this college has value for money.

content.Placements: I recently took admission in B.Tech in ECE at GGU. My JEE CRL rank is 84000. After coming to campus, I heard from professors that there are no placements in this college. Only 2 to 5 percent of students are placed here. The highest package is 5 LPA on campus, and the lowest is Rs 90,000 per annum. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Mahindra, and Tata Steel. 50 to 60 percent of students got internships by college or outside sources. Top role is circular designer.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is overall good. Wi-Fi is also available but it does not work properly. On this campus there is a central library. In hostels, the food they provide like roti is so hard and dal is fully water. One thing that is good here is snacks in the evening. The sports facility is good but not like NIT and IIT. There is one cafeteria in our college. Free medical facilities are provided by college.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: What should I do to get a direct admission in Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya?
faqs.answer: It is true that admission to GGU (Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya) can be obtained without taking the Vishwavidyalaya Entrance Test, or GGU VET ( direct addmission are open). Admission requirements for the various undergraduate and graduate programmes offered by GGU may differ. While certain programmes may have various entry requirements, such merit-based selection or other entrance tests, others may require the GGU VET. To find out if the GGU VET is required for the programme you are interested in, it is essential to review the entrance requirements specifically for that programme.

reviews.review_heading: Average college for students of law. Teachers are very good, and the college infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of our B.A. The LL.B. law department is very nice and well-settled. All books are available in the law department library. We didn't face any problems there. The Wi-Fi also works very well. The hostel is very good for accommodation. The food is also very good and edible. The cafeteria, medical facilities, and sports games are also very good. Games are played on their scheduled time.

reviews.review_heading: Very unique chance to get.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. There are different grounds for different sports. The library is good. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. There are different canteens inside the college. In college, there is first aid medical present.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good college for this course.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. Labs are spacious. Classrooms are good and digitally updated. Hostels are 2-seated or 3-seated rooms. Mess food is average. Library is good but has timings. There are different indoor and outdoor grounds for different sports.

reviews.review_heading: A very good government college is less expensive.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available all over the campus, and CCTV security is in place. There are many hostels inside the campus. Classrooms are spacious and have all the facilities like projectors and smartboards. Labs are spacious and have all the apparatus used in industry. There are many cafeteria restaurants inside the campus. There are many grounds for different sports.

reviews.review_heading: According to me, this college has value for money.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is overall good. Wi-Fi is also available but it does not work properly. On this campus there is a central library. In hostels, the food they provide like roti is so hard and dal is fully water. One thing that is good here is snacks in the evening. The sports facility is good but not like NIT and IIT. There is one cafeteria in our college. Free medical facilities are provided by college.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The courses offered by the university are very good which cover all necessary subjects and topics related to the present scenario in various fields. It also organises seminars and research-related work for the students, and then they review the program to determine whether it has been successfully done or needs to be organised again. Hostels are awesome with all basic amenities, having nominal charges on a yearly basis, not more than Rs 5000. All rooms are shared on a basis of 2 persons with sep...

reviews.review_heading: It provides affordable education with average facilities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is average but usable. Classrooms are spacious but many need better maintenance and modern teaching equipment. The library is large and has enough books for academic use though digital resources are limited. Wi-Fi is available on campus but the speed and connectivity are not consistent. Hostel facilities are basic, rooms are decent but overcrowding is an issue. Mess food quality is average and repetitive. Medical facilities are basic, and sports facilities are available but not we...

reviews.review_heading: GGV - A Considerably Good University.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi in all departments, and it always works. It's good, we can log in with our enrollment ID. Some classrooms are new, and some are old. We have an integrated big library named Nalanda Central Library. There is everything available, from AC to copying services. The mess food is also of good quality, and we have small Nescafés, Amul, and a separate canteen too. It's very good, and sports and games are organized every now and then in our playground.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Chhattisgarh Institute of Medical Sciences, BilaspurReviewed on 9 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is a bit run-down, but manageable with good professors.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the lecture hall is fine, there is AC and a projector, so no complaints about it, where wi-fi labs and library are available. The 1st and 2nd Year hostels are really good with attached bathrooms, but the main hostel is a little bit run-down. Medical facilities are top-notch, not much sports and games are available, and the mess and canteen are okay.

reviews.review_heading: I think it's needed reforms.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, not better than good. Classroom is awesome. Library is well maintained. We got fabulous professors and scholars, and office staff. Even the guard is very protective. They scolded, but they love students. Food quality is good. 10 rupees Swabhiman Thali is good for students, we can get proper dal, bhat, sabji. Sports ground is enough, but there are no players.

reviews.review_heading: Very low charges in this college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Hostels are good, they are 2-seater and 3-seater. There are many grounds for different sports. There are canteens, cafeteria restaurants, etc., on the campus. Wi-Fi is all over the campus. Labs are spacious and have all the apparatus used in industry. Classrooms are good.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: There is a separate hostel for 1st-year students and the senior hostel. The 1st-year hostel is good, but the senior hostels are not that great. However, the good news is that the hostels were renovated and most of the issues have been overcome. The fee for the hostel is reasonable. I am interested in Economics as a domain and want to pursue public policy. The student-to-teacher ratio is 1:5. The faculty is experienced and qualified as per UGC guidelines. The teaching methods were quite good, enc...

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it was the best college for the M.Sc. in Botany course.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was not available at our college. Labs were better when there were more PCs, but we had fewer classrooms because students studied less. The library had many books. The computer was easy to access for studying and finding textbooks. There was no food or restaurant on campus. Even water was not readily available there.

reviews.review_heading: Very inexpensive Central University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. First aid kit and a hospital inside the campus. There are many grounds for different sports. There are hostels for boys and girls inside the campus. Most of the hostels are 3-seated and 2-seated. Mess food is average. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. Labs are good, they have all the apparatus used in industry.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college in Bilaspur.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, it makes us feel good. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. There are many hostels inside the campus. Hostels are 3-seated and 2-seated. Mess food is average. There are many grounds for different sports. There are cafeterias and canteen food inside the campus. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.

IIITDM Kancheepuram offers admission to undergraduate, postgraduate, integrated, and doctoral courses. Aspirants seeking admission to IIIT Chennai have to appear in the national-level entrance exam conducted every year.The institute accepts JEE Main, GATE, and CEED exams for admission to its UG and PG programmes.After that, candidates have to appear in the Centralised Counseling process for seat allotment. Apart from the UG and PG courses a few PhD course are also offered at the doctoral level byIIITDM Kancheepuram.

IIITM Kancheepuram admission 2025 to most courses are entrance-based. In BTech, candidates are admitted based on their performance in JEE Main. MTech aspirants will get admission through the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) and for MDes, CEED is consider for admission. However, candidates must qualify the IIIT Kancheepuram eligibility criteria. Given below is the list of courses offered by the institute along with their eligibility, and selection criteria :
Class 12 with a minimum 75% aggregate

IIITDM Kancheepuram fees range from INR 2 lakh to INR 7 lakh. The fees include multiple components such as a certificate/thesis fee, student welfare fee, alumni life membership fee, etc. IIIT Kancheepuram offers 500+ seats for its UG an PG course. Find below IITDM Kancheepuram seats and fees for admission 2025:

IIITDM Kancheepuram Admission 2025 for the UG course will be done through JoSSA/CSAB based on JEE(Main) rank. Additionally, for the MTech/MDes courses admission is conducted through GATE and CEED followed by CCMT counselling. Check below the complete IIITDM Kancheepuram Admission Process.
Step 1 IIITDM Kancheepuram Application process.

The UG and PG admission requires the candidate to fill out the application form by registering using the course-wise entrance exams. In case of BTech, the applicants have to go to the official site and the JEE Main. And in the case of the MTech, the applicants must apply using the CCMT web site.
Step 2: IIITDM Kancheepuram Selection Rounds.

On its flagship course of BTech, IIITDM Kancheepuram also takes students with a valid JEE Main score. JoSAA Counselling allocates seats to the candidates. MTech is admired by GATE after which it undergoes CCMT Counselling.
Step 3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The cutoff for BTech and MTech courses is released by the respective counselling bodies.JEE Main releases cutoffs for BTechafter the conclusion of both Session 1 and Session 2 exams. Candidates are shortlisted based on the cutoff. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

paragraphs: IIITDM Kancheepuram has concluded its placement season for 2025. The overall placement rate achieved during the 2025 placement season stood at 61.9% , however, the percentage of offers received was 76.2%. A total of 260 students registered for the placements, out of which 198 received placement offers. Overall 161 students secured placements during the IIIT Kancheepuram placement season. The highest package provided to students during IIITDM Kancheepuram placements was INR 32.57 LPA.

The institute has also released the course-wise and department-wise placement data for 2025. The average package offered for BTech, MTech, and MDes batch was INR 9.42 LPA, INR 10.20 LPA, and INR 6.59 LPA , respectively. The number of offers given to BTech students was 176 additionally, MTech and MDes received 14 and 8 offers , respectively.

reviews.review_heading: I am student at IIITDM Kancheepuram.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is fine, and they will clean the washrooms daily. They will also clean the floors. The quality of food and taste is also okay but once or twice every 2 weeks, the mess food is not that much tasty and well prepared. They will provide high-protein foods like paneer and dal. For right now, there is no chicken curry for free so we have to pay the bill. Sports are available like cricket, football, badminton, volleyball, basketball, cricket, chess, carrom, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent infrastructure and friendly campus vibe.
reviews.review_text: Lecture halls are technologically equipped to support dynamic discussions. Group discussion and interview room support placement activities. The entire campus, including the academic blocks and hostels Wi-Fi is enabled. LAN connections are also available in hostels. We have advanced department labs.  The institute has specialized labs across disciplines.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is good, faculty is .
reviews.review_text: I can give 4 stars, which is more than enough. Classrooms and library, I can give 4-4.5. The mess is below average. The medical facility is good. Sports and games, I can give 4.5.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college to study if you have a lower rank to join NITs.
reviews.review_text: Small rooms for freshers. Building a new one until then, average rooms. Food is good. Sports are the best thing in college. Wi-Fi is not available in the hostel rooms, whereas you get Ethernet, which does not often work properly, but you can get Wi-Fi in college.

reviews.review_heading: Mess food is below average.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi (Ethernet) is, I can give 4 stars more than enough, classrooms and library I can give 4-4.5 stars, mess is below average, medical facility is good, sports and games I can give 4.5, sometimes they have Ethernet access. There is one canteen in college, and the price is affordable.

reviews.review_heading: Indian Institute of Information Technology.
reviews.review_text: We have the best infrastructure provided by the government. We have nice AC classrooms and AC hostel rooms. We have Wi-Fi available here all the time. We also have so many libraries here and so many labs for doing experiments. We have so many varieties of food items here

reviews.review_heading: Management is responsible, and I won't recommend this institute. Join other IIITs and NITs.
reviews.review_text: Library is small and closed on Sunday. Wi-Fi works only in the academic block, and it won't work in hostels. Classrooms are limited and small. Lab is just a waste of time. Food is the worst in my opinion. No proper hygiene, and the institute will not claim its mistake. There is no lighting on campus, and water in hostels will stop at 11:00 AM. No one cares about you.

reviews.review_heading: It's good for everything, but it offers average packages only.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, library, and everything is good, you can participate in many sports, and the gym is also there. Washing machines are available in hostels, everything is good, labs and infrastructure are also good. I recommend you come to this beautiful campus. The campus is so good and hostels are good.

reviews.review_heading: IIITDM Kancheepuram is an overall package that is good for academics and cultural events.
reviews.review_text: In IIITDM Kancheepuram with respect to the ECE department facilities, labs are well-equipped and teachers are knowledgeable. The hostel has a LAN facility, and the library has a good Wi-Fi facility. The hostel rooms are provided with necessities, but the only issue is that it is a bit congested on one half of the hostel block for boys. The food provided is decent, there is no non-veg menu but it can be accessed by purchasing a separate token for it. Medical facilities are good. Sports are top-no...

reviews.review_heading: Placements are good, faculty members are not very good but okay. Food is not good.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are good some are bad (last floor). Hostel fee is compact. Medical facilities are good enough. There are 2 basketball courts, 5 badminton courts, 2 large grounds, one for cricket, one for football, 2 volleyball courts, 1 table tennis, and a kabaddi court. We also have kho-kho court and 2 table tennis courts. We have a large gym and indoor games are available like carrom and chess.

reviews.review_heading: Noteworthy placements, good infrastructure, and some good faculty.
reviews.review_text: Unlike many other colleges in IIITDM K students are required to use LAN in hostels which can be inconvenient sometimes. The library is just like any other library you might have come across. There is a separate building with 2 floors of library and other floors connection labs. Then about classrooms, all classes are not the same. Some have ACs while others don't. The messy food is nothing to worry about. There is a medical center open all the time. In sports and games, IIITDM K has been the lead...

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIITDM Kancheepuram - Indian Institute of Information Technology Design & Manufacturing.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is great, very close to nature and it is very peaceful. The hostel is good with great facilities. The only problem is the weather is a bit harsh, as it is Chennai. The college buildings and hostel buildings are very nice they are great.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a considerable college for good campus life. Best in creative and innovative ideas.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is really good in terms of infrastructure, with spacious hostel rooms and 2 students per room. In our department, classrooms are huge and well-maintained. The hostel mess is also comparatively good. We have two messes that are well maintained with hygienic food and clean plates. They ensure cleanliness in the mess and provide both South Indian and North Indian dishes in both messes.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good, but placements are average.
reviews.review_text: We should really appreciate the infrastructure of laboratories, but classrooms have a very weak Wi-Fi connection. The library is a bit small. Cafeteria food is actually not so good. I have fallen sick too. Mess food is appreciable but the saddest part is we need to pay extra for non-veg, which costs around Rs. 30. Medical facilities are good with free treatment for all common illnesses and health camps too. Sports and games are also given importance with large grounds but playing equipment is le...

reviews.review_heading: I made a good decision by joining it. It has a good college life and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our college is built on a total of 52 acres in which there are 4 hostels, 1 academic block, 1 laboratory block, 1 mess, 1 cafeteria, 1 sports complex, 1 provisions store which is more than enough for the campus students. The total strength is nearly 2500. we have access to Wi-Fi in all the places where buildings are there. It has good medical facilities. The mess food is average but all other things are above average. Some workers maintain the college campus regularly.

reviews.review_heading: Best college and teaching quality is good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good and very beautiful. The classrooms are good. The computer labs are good. The Wi-Fi facility is also available. Many books are available in the library. reviews.review_heading: The college is furnished with high-standard furniture and digital classrooms.
reviews.review_text: College provides a rich environment with a green and clean campus. Wi-Fi is throughout. Classrooms and library are top-notch. Labs are furnished with high-quality desktops and processors. Labs are fully equipped. They maintained regularly.

reviews.review_heading: It is good for study, strict sometimes.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good and well-maintained. As it is near the outer area, traveling is a bit harder. All the rooms and facilities in the college are maintained well. reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good campus. Satisfied with the facilities and placements.
reviews.review_text: IARE College started in the year 2000. It has completed 25 years. Facilities and infrastructure are good. Here we have good Wi-Fi, laboratories, and a library too. The quality of food in the hostel is good compared to the private hostels outside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: It's good for the placement for the students.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for the course subject include classrooms with good teaching skills and deep subject knowledge explanations. reviews.review_heading: According to my rating, I will rate my college 4/5, the facilities and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good but some of the facilities are not up to the mark. I am a day scholar, and I do not know about the food and the other stuff. The canteen in college is well cleaned and they provide quality food with hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: The best engineering college for a middle-class student who can't afford lacs of fees.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and labs are good enough to work on current technology. Even in the hostel, they provide very good facilities like Wi-Fi, etc. Sports and games are well managed. Every lab in my college consists of more than 50 computers, and they are well-conditioned and work with the latest technology.

reviews.review_heading: Great learning experience with strong placements and supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: High-speed campus-wide Wi-Fi is accessible in classrooms, labs, libraries, and common areas. Thousands of books on AI, ML, Data Science, CSE, and core engineering.

reviews.review_heading: I chose this branch as it's trending now. Events are few, but when done, they do it nicely.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good. Environment and placements are also very good.
reviews.review_text: We have a computer lab with proper equipment. We have a basketball ground where we all spend time. We also have the best Wi-Fi in the college. Every room has an air conditioning facility. Mike is also good in our classroom. Medicine is properly given by our teacher.

reviews.review_heading: The review of the best college in Salt Lake Sector V.
reviews.review_text: The classes are really good with modern technologies. Labs are fully air-conditioned. I am not a hosteller, so I don't know if the medical facilities are good. The institution is very keen on sports and games. They often host events, sports competitions, marathons, and football tournaments, which make us feel very energetic after hectic exams.

reviews.review_heading: A campus for perfect discipline.
reviews.review_text: The course and college infrastructure are good. There have been continuous complaints with the hostel, its food quality, and the quality of usage and drinking water of the hostel. There are no provisions for AC in the hostel as of November, 2025. During the summer, coolers are provided in rooms with extra charges per month. The hostel fee for 12 months needs to be paid in one go before the commencement of the session.

reviews.review_heading: IEM Salt Lake BCA: Strong placements, decent infrastructure, and good supportive faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Average infrastructure with basic labs and classrooms that need modernization. Hostel facilities are limited, with small rooms and average food quality. Libraries are good and updated with all required books. It's not good, at least in my opinion, it's a 3/5 rating.

reviews.review_heading: The best private college. Good placements and the teachers are so helpful.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not so much fancy. The food quality of the hostel and canteen is very good. There are also good medical facilities available in the college sports zone, like a basketball court, which is also there. They organize sports tournaments, also interschool.

reviews.review_heading: IEM Kolkata - An overview of the total experience.
reviews.review_text: IEM does have modern technologies, but it surely lacks a lot in infrastructure when compared to other institutions. The college hostel does provide proper housing facilities and food. However, it cannot directly compare to the best food we would find around the area.

reviews.review_heading: Good, but not the best. I think it's average.
reviews.review_text: Our college provided us with many facilities, such as labs for every subject, like C lab, Data Structure lab, Java lab, and IT lab. 24/7 LAN connectivity, fresh environment, and equipment.

reviews.review_heading: We have a good infrastructure and facilities. The library is 24/7, and events happen every weekend.
reviews.review_text: The quality of the food in the mess is good, and medical facilities are also available 24/7. Sports and games have good facilities as well. The faculty and infrastructure are really nice, the Wi-Fi is always available, and the library is open all day. The classrooms are quite well advanced.

reviews.review_heading: It has a well-equipped campus with good placements and supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our department has smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, high-speed Wi-Fi, and access to a central library. Hostels are decent with clean rooms, average mess food, and medical support. It has good sports facilities like basketball, cricket, and a gym. However, other facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Average life of an engineer at IEM.
reviews.review_text: The college has well-organized labs with Wi-Fi. Libraries are available all the time for the students to study. The college provides opportunities for students to participate in different sports fields. There are also good medical facilities available for all students and staff.

reviews.review_heading: Course, facility, and teachers are good. Students get placements and internships.
reviews.review_text: All  types of labs, library, and Wi-Fi are also available. Hostel and food are hygienic. In the library, every type of book is available for higher studies, and books are also available. There is a canteen in our college. 100MB  Wi-Fi will be given to every student.

reviews.review_heading: As per the facilities, IEM is the best college. I am happy to study at IEM College.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available at the college include purified drinking water, and there is a playground on our campus. IEM College has a big library. Our college has a big seminar hall. Our college has fully equipped labs.

reviews.review_heading: It is a strict college that provides all the facilities with good placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The library and labs are available and easily accessible. There are smart classrooms with AC and Wi-Fi that are also available. The canteen is good, but a bit expensive. We have a games room and a sports teacher too. Medical rooms are also there on every campus, and doctors are there. All kinds of medicine are available.

reviews.review_heading: With supportive faculty, decent placements, and a good campus life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for all departments is good. We have Wi-Fi-enabled labs, modern classrooms with projectors, and a well-maintained library in our college. There is good average mess food, a gym, medical facilities, doctor visits, CCTV, a playground, and 2 or 3-seater rooms. IEM is the best.

reviews.review_heading: IEM - A college with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Each floor has a Wi-Fi connection, classrooms are clean and well arranged, and library is also very big. Hostel is average. Quality of food is not so good whereas there is good medical care. All kinds of sports and games are facilities. There is a basketball court on campus.

hostel_campus.college_name: Integral University Lucknow Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: Integral University has 3 hostels for boys and 2 hostels for girls. The facilities provided in the hostels are common room equipped with indoor game facilities, playground and courts for outdoor games like badminton, volleyball, cricket, skating, lawn tennis, basketball, etc., gymnasium, 24 Hrs. wi-fi, water purifier, parking, guest rooms, reading room.
facilities: The campus is only 30 km from Lucknow airport and railway station
The seminar hall is well-equipped with audio-visual facilities and can accommodate 400 students
Two special lecture theatres are available for closer interaction between the recruiters and the students. Each lecture theatre is built like an amphitheatre and has a seating of 80 students
Air-conditioned group discussion rooms/ interview rooms/ conference rooms

library.description: Integral University has central as well as departmental library. The central library has the collection of more than 0.1 million documents comprising of books, theses, journals, dissertations and CDs/DVDs in the fields of applied sciences, bio sciences, engineering, medical sciences, education, humanities, literature and management with a seating capacity of 600 readers. The library collection includes 99255 volumes. The library also has the subscription of 300 printed and 7010 online journals with 2731 eBooks, 47000 articles, 3700 full text articles and 5875 indexed articles through online databases like Oxford university press, Cambridge university press. The library is fully automated by automated software KOHA.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the faculty and also with the university system.
reviews.review_text: We do not get any facilities for 1.5 lakhs, as it's the charge for 1 year of stay in the hostel. The hostel does not have AC. We don't get a single almirah or single B.Ed or anything else. It does not have a Wi-Fi system. There is no mess system included in it, and we have to give extra charges for the mess system. We don't have access to go out or in anytime we want. The room area is full of dust, or we can say the paint on the walls is very old. It has scratches. There is no single cleaner in ...

reviews.review_heading: The college gave good placements.
reviews.review_text: The facilities of labs and classrooms are good, and the Wi-Fi network is also very good. The library is not very good, the facilities of the hostel are quite bad, and the food in the hostel is also poor. The ground is very good at our university, and many sports are played there.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing, and most of the students are satisfied with the infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure is great, with privacy and security at their best. The food in the hostel is hygienic and tasty. They have a very dynamic schedule for dinner, lunch, and breakfast, and they also provide snacks every evening around 5 pm. The rooms are well cleaned and have good bed quality. They also provide medical facilities and a sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the university is excellent. Faculty members are good, but the placement rate is low.
reviews.review_text: My course is B.Sc. Biotechnology, and its fee is Rs. 90,000 per year. Hostel fees are separate and vary according to the type of room you choose. Mainly, two kinds of rooms are available here. They are AC and non-AC. The rooms are triple-sharing. Classrooms are well-equipped with projectors, microphones, and speakers.

reviews.review_heading: If you are serious about your studies, then you can study here otherwise, you cannot.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the labs, and AC is also available. Every classroom department has its library, and there is a Central library where you can study. The quality of the hostel is very good. Food is average, and the mess is there. All medical facilities, sports, and games are also available.

reviews.review_heading: The teachers are very helpful and help with students' careers.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for the course are great, including internet connection, different kinds of labs, smart classrooms, and a library. The quality of facilities is good in the hostel, the mess, and the canteen. Medical facilities have improved, and games are conducted regularly.

reviews.review_heading: Now the teachers are very good, and they help in students' career building.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure were good. We had strong Wi-Fi connection and different kinds of labs, digital classroom, and library. The quality of facilities in hostel was hygienic, and provided 3 times meals. All meds were available in the medical room. There was a small playground in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Earlier faculty never focused on students that's why students can't get good placed.
reviews.review_text: The best quality of infrastructure available like good internet Wi-Fi speed, smart classroom, and different kinds of library were there. Facilities available in hostel were fully air-conditioned bedroom and good quality food. Medical facilities were good enough, and mini field was there for playing games.

reviews.review_heading: A good university with a good atmosphere, nothing is over the board as I have seen at other colleges
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and hostel are good, with the constant change and upgrades going on, they are improving it, and its getting better through my 4 years. I have seen great investment in infrastructure, which helps a lot as a student, and it feels good.

reviews.review_heading: Now the faculty is old-fashioned.
reviews.review_text:
There are more facilities like better smart classes available, a big library available for students, and different laboratories available for students. 
One of the best quality food served in the hostel, better canteen hygiene is good, air-conditioned bedrooms, a medical room available, and a big ground for the students.

reviews.review_heading: A good and lovely college.
reviews.review_text: It is verified by NAAC with an A+ grade, so it has good infrastructure and a good campus view with a playground, library, auditorium, and many more facilities provided by the college. The infrastructure, as well as the nature and environment of the college, is very good.

reviews.review_heading: It's fantastic, and its infrastructure is very good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is excellent. It has a very big campus with a cafeteria and garden area. You can just sit in the garden and spend time with your friends. There is a library with extremely good and helpful books which we can take from there. They also have AC in the classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very nice. Teaching staff is very good and helpful and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities like museum, labs, classes, smart classes, and library are well maintained and managed on 7 floors. Library has every book needed.  We get free Wi-Fi on campus. It provides best infrastructure. Some classes are AC classes, good canteen, and fresh food served.

reviews.review_heading: Integral University: A university that gives wings to your dreams.
reviews.review_text: The university has AC classrooms with A1 infrastructure, Wi-Fi available for students, smart boards and projectors in every classroom, and a library with fully furnished ACs, teachers are very supportive and provide different types of study materials like PDFs and notes; the hostel infrastructure is top class with AC in every room, elevators along with stairs featuring the latest technology in both hostel and university buildings, healthy and tasty food with proper hygiene is prepared at the can...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Although facilities are good. Infrastructure is good. Canteen and eating outlets are there. We have good transportation system and budget friendly. Good food is available at university with pocket-friendly prices. Departments are good and clean with good environment.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure and facilities.

review_content.Placements: 60-70% of my seniors are placed in various companies. Some have salary of 5 LPA - 6 LPA. 15 students (my seniors) got research internships in various IITs like IIT Guwahati, IIT Jodhpur. 30-35% of students got internships. You can get roles like power system engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are top-notch. It has free access to Wi-Fi all over the campus (requires authorisation, daily 1GB limit). We have multiple labs with all the equipments. Classrooms are also good. There is a separate 4-floor building entirely for library (it's an open library, where even outside can study), it has countless books, reading room, research labs. Hostel building is good. A room is shared by 3 people (rooms are a little small), and quality of food served in mess is good. They have a clinic with an ambulance service for critical cases. Various sports are available.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Limited exposure requires extra effort and developing over time.

review_content.Placements: Placements are average, but most secure jobs or higher studies. CSE is the best here after NIT Srinagar. IUST collaborates with IIT for internships. Companies like Amazon, IBM, and Wipro visit. The median package is 5.4 LPA. The highest salary is 7 LPA. One senior secured 65 LPA off-campus in 2024.
review_content.Infrastructure: It's decent and depends on how much you can adjust. Classrooms are spacious with Wi-Fi. The campus is beautiful, surrounded by mountains. There are canteens, cafes, stationery shops, medical facilities, and a well-equipped library. Hostels lack Wi-Fi, wardens are strict, and the mess food is above average.

review_summary.college_name: Islamic University of Science and Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Think before you choose, must read this review first.

content.Placements: Placements are good, mainly depending on our skills. More skilled students have chances of getting placed. Almost 60% of students get placed. The highest package is around 9 LPA, and minimum is 1 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Paras Health, Bharat Petroleum, etc. Top roles offered are software engineer and web developed.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good infrastructure. It has nice buildings but doesn't have digital boards in every class. Our college has good natural environment. A lot of canteens are available on the campus. Food quality is good both veg and non-veg. For sports, you can play cricket, basketball but don't have much indoor sports facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Review of Islamic University of Science and Technology.

content.Placements: Placements are not that good, but I can say they are average placements. But recently saw a little spike in placements. I don't know about the highest package, but recently, many students from the CS department got placed at good companies. All the students get internships.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel and infrastructure are very good. The hostels are new, fully furnished, and the food is also good. Classrooms are nicely furnished. For sports, they have two major grounds. Most importantly, they have a roomy library where students can go and study at any time.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: 60-70% of my seniors are placed in various companies. Some have salary of 5 LPA - 6 LPA. 15 students (my seniors) got research internships in various IITs like IIT Guwahati, IIT Jodhpur. 30-35% of students got internships. You can get roles like power system engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are top-notch. It has free access to Wi-Fi all over the campus (requires authorisation, daily 1GB limit). We have multiple labs with all the equipments. Classrooms are also good. There is a separate 4-floor building entirely for library (it's an open library, where even outside can study), it has countless books, reading room, research labs. Hostel building is good. A room is shared by 3 people (rooms are a little small), and quality of food served in mess is good. They have a clinic with an ambulance service for critical cases. Various sports are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Limited exposure requires extra effort and developing over time.

content.Placements: Placements are average, but most secure jobs or higher studies. CSE is the best here after NIT Srinagar. IUST collaborates with IIT for internships. Companies like Amazon, IBM, and Wipro visit. The median package is 5.4 LPA. The highest salary is 7 LPA. One senior secured 65 LPA off-campus in 2024.
content.Infrastructure: It's decent and depends on how much you can adjust. Classrooms are spacious with Wi-Fi. The campus is beautiful, surrounded by mountains. There are canteens, cafes, stationery shops, medical facilities, and a well-equipped library. Hostels lack Wi-Fi, wardens are strict, and the mess food is above average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Food Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The university campus is good.

content.Placements: Almost 80% of students got placed in this course. This course has a package of rupees 1.5 LPA which is maximum and minimum of Rs 50,000. Nestle, Amul, and Britannia are recruiting companies. Almost 60% of students got internships in companies like Nescafe. Food technologies, quality manager, consumer safety officer, and many more roles are offered.
content.Infrastructure: Our department has a lot of facilities such as well-equipped labs, good Wi-Fi, spacious classrooms, and library with a lot of good books available. The hostel has good facilities. The food in the mess is good, and canteen is good as well. Medical facilities are also available. A lot of sports can be played here. There are a lot of games that we can play.

reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good. The university is young and is growing rapidly. The classrooms are spacious, and the campus is quite huge with fields around. It has a lot of cafeterias and nice, spacious auditoriums; however, there is less scope for sports.

reviews.review_heading: IUST infrastructure is really good, located at a very good place, placements not so good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was good. The hostel was good, but the food available was not good. Games were good, medical facilities were good, and sports were very good. They took us to various colleges for different competitions and events. The overall experience with the college was good.

reviews.review_heading: IUST and the academic life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very nice and well built. There are buildings with top facilities and the labs regarding each course are much more advanced. Rumi library is where all sorts of books and journals are available and hostels are also very nice, well maintained and very clean. The food is also very hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: It was a mistake to take admission to this very university that I might regret throughout my life.
reviews.review_text: Good but not great as compared to the fee that you're paying and also, sports facilities are the worst ever. There are no proper indoor or outdoor facilities for the respective games and you can't even complain as they are full of excuses. The rules are hectic, which are not even in IITs and you're forced to follow them; otherwise, you'll get punished.

reviews.review_heading: Review for the Islamic University of Science and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this university is great. Buildings are designed with new technology and have all the facilities that a modern building could have. They are well-furnished and organized very well. Classrooms are neat and clean, having all the facilities and having Wi-Fi too; labs are well-equipped, having all the instruments and chemicals needed; and the library is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good in everything but lacks placements.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a beautiful infrastructure and every possible facility from sports to labs. Our college has high-speed internet, and the labs are equipped with the latest machines, computers, etc. Classrooms have modern equipment like smart boards and speakers. It also has good food.

content.Infrastructure: Well, I will say that in terms of infrastructure, this is the best. It's so goated that multiple movies, web series, and ads are being shot here. Classrooms are well-equipped with centralized AC, smart boards, speakers, and Wi-Fi. The library is also well-spaced and has a lot of books and quite a space to study. The hostel is also the best according to infrastructure, and the mess food, I would say, is okayish. Hostels have good Wi-Fi and hot and cold showers, and a sports ground.

content.Placements: My course is BCA Computer Applications, which is related to AI. The students are required to have above 80 percent for a well-seated option in the YMCA. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure with well-equipped labs and an active campus environment.

content.Placements: For Mechanical Engineering at JSPM RSCOE, around 60-70% of students get placed, with packages ranging from 2.4 LPA (the lowest) to about 6-7 LPA (the highest), an average of 3-3.5 LPA, recruiters like TCS, Capgemini, KPIT, Bosch and core manufacturing firms, internships for 50-60% students, and roles such as Graduate Engineer Trainee, Design/Production Engineer, and Technical Associate.
content.Infrastructure: Department has campus-wide Wi-Fi, well-equipped mechanical labs (workshop, CNC, CAD/CAM, metrology, thermal and fluid labs), smart classrooms with projectors, and a well-stocked central library with textbooks, reference books and e-resources. While hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms and basic amenities, mess food is average but hygienic with a functional canteen, and basic medical facilities are available on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Jspm RSCO best college for all branches.

content.Placements: 65% students are placed in college per year. In which some top students get a high package. The highest package achieved by JSPM RSCO alumni is 1cr. The Average package range is 6LPA to 12LPA. The lowest package is 4LPA. There are many top companies linked with the JSPM scope like KPI, KPI, and many more. Students get internship from the second year at abroad companies with 25k minimum stipend per month.
content.Infrastructure: In our college 24/7 Wi-Fi hot water filtered water and a watchman or guardian. In hostel the food quality is not bad. The college has a ground for sports, and also conducts games and competitions.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Somewhat recommended as they have a good course structure for academics.

content.Placements: They provide good placements, but Mech students go to Capgemini and Cognizant. They force them to apply there. Even though we are not interested in coding. Overall, core companies like JCI and others also come, but these days, competition is very high.
content.Infrastructure: Half the college is under renovation right now. They are making everything new again. There are 3 canteens, all of which are good and provide okayish food. Hostels are located on the campus. The general stores, too, so students do not have to go out unless they opt for PG.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The autonomous system allows the college to design its own syllabus.

content.Placements: If you are looking for a college only for academics, then this is the one. So, the electrical department here is actually very strict. If you are looking for them, you need to be flexible with your attendance. Please do not expect this. However, teachers are really great. They really do help you with everything. This year, the placement is 97%. The average package is 3 LPA - 4 LPA with the highest being 11 LPA, and the lowest being 2.5 LPA. I hope this helps you.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are really good. The classrooms are pretty good, and labs are also available. Canteen and mess are also pretty good, and food is great. The infrastructure is modern, with Wi-Fi-enabled campus. It has well-equipped labs, and a good library.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good campus and all instruments are available.

content.Placements: As per the records, we have seen in the college. The average package is about 3 LPA, but this year. There is about a 97% placement in electrical engineering. And the remaining 3 are gone for higher studies. Our HOD is very concerned about placement and does all things that are required for students.
content.Infrastructure: In the department, the course we are studying is good. The instruments are in good condition. If any are defective, they will replace/repair them. They strictly monitor the food quality and cleanliness in the hostel, and an external person is not allowed.

This is followed by other steps, such as application, selection, and seat confirmation. Interested students can see the below steps to complete theKIET University admission process:
KIET Ghaziabad Application Process 2026

Students can apply online at the official site of KIET Ghaziabad. To complete the process, students need to submit the application with documents and fees before the last date of admission. The university then verifies the submitted documents.
Entrance Examination Scores

KIET Ghaziabad selects candidates based on their scores in entrance exams such as JEE Main, CUET, GPAT, CAT, etc. Before applying students must check the minimum eligibility of the programme at the university and make sure that those are met. Check the entrance examination that is accepted for selection and appear for the same.
Selection Process

The admission committee screens candidates and shortlists them on the basis of the respective entrance exam scores and if the eligibility requirement is met. Students have to appear for national-level exams and meet theKIET University cutoffto be eligible.
Admission Confirmation

Shortlisted candidates will be extended the provisional admission confirmation and must confirm their admission by paying theKIET Ghaziabad fees. Admitted students need to complete academic registration and come for the university orientation programme.
