paragraphs: The Corporate Relations and Placement Centre at KIET University aims to assist students in defining their educational and career objectives, while also providing them with job-seeking skills to secure their dream job. KIET recorded a placement rate of 86.79%. A total of 1,106 students secured placements from BTech , MTech , MBA , etc. More than 370 companies offered a total of 2,268 offers to its students. review_content.Placements: Placements at KLE Teach are decent but not the best. I have seen and heard from seniors that roughly 40-50% students manage to get placed. The biggest recruiters are Infosys, Wipro, TCS, Bosch, and Deloitte. The average package offered is around 4 LPA. review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has a really good infrastructure. Classrooms are clean, spacious, and well-equipped with projectors and Wi-Fi. Labs are well-maintained with the required equipment. The library is big with plenty of books and digital resources. Hostel rooms are decent with proper facilities, and Wi-Fi works fine. Mess food is okay, but not like home, but it's still manageable. While the canteen has better options. Sports facilities like basketball, cricket, and indoor games are available. Overall, campus infrastructure is supported for both academics and student life.

content.Infrastructure: Labs are good and have good instructors and equipment. But one thing is that equipment are not enough and get outnumbered by the number of students. Faculty members are knowledgeable but do not have an interest in teaching us; most of them are like that. Only a few of the faculty members are supportive and help us to skill up.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Decent college with great facilities on campus, but the academics can be better.

content.Placements: Placements at KLE Teach are decent but not the best. I have seen and heard from seniors that roughly 40-50% students manage to get placed. The biggest recruiters are Infosys, Wipro, TCS, Bosch, and Deloitte. The average package offered is around 4 LPA. Most of the offers are for roles in IT services, software development, testing, and consulting. Core branch students also get a few opportunities. Around 30-40% manage to get placed through the college of tie-ups.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a really good infrastructure. Classrooms are clean, spacious, and well-equipped with projectors and Wi-Fi. Labs are well-maintained with the required equipment. The library is big with plenty of books and digital resources. Hostel rooms are decent with proper facilities, and Wi-Fi works fine. Mess food is okay, but not like home, but it's still manageable. While the canteen has better options. Sports facilities like basketball, cricket, and indoor games are available. Overall, campus infrastructure is supported for both academics and student life.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty & manageable exams with a decent industry ready curriculum.

content.Placements: Around 70% of ECE students got placed. Packages varied between 3 to 12 LPA with an average of 5 LPA. Recruiters included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Bosch, L&T, Toshiba, AWS, Samsung, and Texas Instruments. Many got internships in core/IT firms. Roles offered are Software, Embedded, and VLSI.
content.Infrastructure: Our department offers Wi-Fi, modern labs, smart classrooms & library access. Hostel has decent rooms with study areas, the mess food is average, but the canteen is better. Medical help, 24/7 security, sports grounds, indoor games, cultural events & gym facilities are provided.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good college for those who really are into engineering.

content.Placements: ECE students are placed into good companies with a great package. Texas Instrument has provided a great package to the ECE students over here, and internships are provided to the students on and off the campus. All sub-branches from ECE are in good placements.
content.Infrastructure: The campus here is huge. We get Wi-Fi all over the college, and get to see all kinds of fully equipped modern labs. The college provides a huge campus that has separate buildings for each department. The canteen offers all kinds of food varieties and a McDonald's connected to the campus.

admission_overview.description: KCT Coimbatore admissions are entrance-based. The college offers admission to specific PG courses based on CEETA PG, TANCET or GATE score. The selection for the flagship programme of KCT i.e. BTech is based on Class 12 score of the candidates followed by TNEA Counselling. Students must pass this exam to proceed to the next semester. BTech Admission is entrance based at MAKAUT. For admission to this course, students should have valid scores in JEE Main or MHT CET exam. The minimum eligibility for the course is passing Class 12 with atleast 45% aggregate in PCM/PCMB stream. Students must meet the minimum eligibility ofMAKAUT BTechbefore applying for admission to the same. The programme offers over 700 specialisations, thus providing students with a wide range of choices.

faqs.question: Does MAKAUT grant direct admission to BTech programme?
faqs.answer: No, admission to BTech programme at MAKAUT is entrance based with the university accepting JEE MAIN scores for the same. Direct admissions are not granted to any student category. The minimum eligibility for BTech mut be met before applying for admission to the same.

faqs.question: What is the duration of BTech programme offered at MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: BTech at MAKAUT fhas a duration of four years. The university follows a semester based system and hence, BTech is divided into 8 semesters. Students must pass each semester exam conducted at the end of each semester to proceed to the next.

faqs.question: Can I change my college under MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: No, candidates do not have the option to change their college under Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology. If they wish to change, they are required to appear for the necessary entrance test again. However, a few articles on the internet mention that students can change their college after the first year but they are required to clear all the exams of the first year for the same. For better clarity on the subject, candidates are advised to reach out to the admission office of MAKAUT or the affiliated institute under the university.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to B.Tech at MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to B.Tech must have a valid score in WBJEE. Those willing to get admission in the second year must appear for JELET (for Lateral Entry). In addition to this, MAKAUT also conducts JEMAT for admission to MBA and Maharashtra courses. Moreover, the university also accepts a few more state/ national-level exams for admission which include WBJEE. PGET, UGC NET (including JRF)/ CSIR NET for admission to other UG, PG and doctoral-level programmes.

faqs.question: How many seats are there for MSc in MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: MAKAUT offers a total of1548 seatsfor its MSc programme. These seats are distributed among more than more than 10 affiliated colleges of the university. Some of the colleges included are the Institute of Management Study, Guru Nanak Institute of Pharmaceutical Science and Technology, and more.

faqs.question: Which exam is required for admission to BCA at MAKAUT?
faqs.answer: MAKAUT offers a full-time BCA programme. In order to get admission, students must appear for CET. It is conducted byMAKAUT WB. Candidates must have qualified Class 12 to appear for this exam.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Sanaka Educational Trust's Group of InstitutionsReviewed on 22 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Very good and prestigious college with good reviews.
reviews.review_text: There is a very good infrastructure in the college with neat and clean classrooms. The whole college has Wi-Fi facilities, modern labs, and a library with many types of technical books. The college has separate hostels for girls and boys. Food is very good and hygienic.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Heritage Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 22 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: HIT is good for value for money, and with a good ROI, you have to work hard here.
reviews.review_text: Everything is good except the first semester. As the machines are old, the remaining library and all are so beautiful, there is no boys' hostel facility in the college, and so it's difficult for the students outside West Bengal. Mess and canteen food is delicious and good at less than a little. Affordable price, sports and games are, but you have to carry the expenses.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by NIT - Narula Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Narula Institute of Technology, the college you can't regret.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Not upto the mark but by far I'll say good. Small campus and things, you'll feel like you're still in school. Food quality is decent. Also, there's a cafeteria and canteen so you get food for really cheap and there are cafes too in front of the college so you will not face any problem. The hostel is outside the campus because the campus is very small like 5 acres.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by iLEAD KolkataReviewed on 20 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Decent college, decent placement, average faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is satisfactory. Classrooms are clean and well-maintained, and basic facilities, such as the library, labs, and Wi-Fi, are available. The food is good, and both veg and non-veg options are available. The hostel is also very clean, and every basic need is available, like AC/Non-AC rooms with fan, light, gas for cooking, washing machines, and other essential things.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by NSHM Institute of Engineering and Technology - NSHM Knowledge Campus DurgapurReviewed on 18 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The college is surrounded by nature and greenery.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi available, the classrooms are pretty decent and the library has ample amount of books. The labs are pretty good. If we talk about mess food, they have lots of variety from veg to non veg.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by Swami Vivekananda Institute of Science and TechnologyReviewed on 18 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: This is the best college for placement and settled in life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, and playground are good. Classrooms are good. The quality of facilities in the hostel is very nice. Food quality is very good, costly but very good. All medical facilities are available, and sports and games are also there. If any student is injured, the medical facilities are top class, so students do not worry about medical treatment.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Haldia Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Decent college for engineering studies.
reviews.review_text: Our department has decent classrooms, a lab, and inside our department, there is a small library which contains only departmental books. Hostel food is not that good, but it is manageable and affordable. Medical facilities are available on the campus 24/7. The gym is also available on the campus.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Techno India UniversityReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: It is a well-known college in India.
reviews.review_text: The college has a small campus. It is neat, clean, and looks very beautiful. All facilities essential for studies are available, like a library, computer labs, and Wi-Fi. The college doesn't have its own hostel. PGs or flats are available near the college.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Heritage Institute of TechnologyReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The college is decent for students who want normal placements at low fees.

reviews.review_heading: This is a review for Bengal College of Engineering and Technology College.
reviews.review_text: The quality of the hostel, faculty members, and classes is also nice and good. The college infrastructure is neat and tidy.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Government College of Engineering and Textile Technology, BerhamporeReviewed on 16 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: My college is so great, and gave me the opportunity to get introduced to the life of engineering.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Greater Kolkata College of Engineering and ManagementReviewed on 14 Jan 2026)

content.Placements: At NIT Manipur, almost 70-80% of the students get placed. The highest package in 2023 was 47 LPA which was given Amazon. In 2023, the average package was around 9.5 LPA. Admission at NIT Manipur require students to fill out the application form by registering for the entrance exams. Candidates seeking admission to PhD courses need to apply on the official website of the institute.

On its flagship course of BTech, NIT Manipur also takes students with a valid JEE Main score. JoSAA Counselling allocates seats to the candidates. paragraphs: NIT Manipur has a placement cell that handles all aspects of campus placements for the graduating students at NIT Manipur. The Cell organizes the campus recruitment training process to train the students through various in-house and out-of-the-house training sessions, including Aptitude tests, Technical tests, Group Discussions (GD), Mock interviews, Workshops, etc. The NIT placement depends on various factors such as the brand value of the institute, industry demand, skills of the students, etc.

The highest package offered during NIT Manipur placements 2023 stood at INR 47 LPA, which was offered by Amazon. Further, a total of 37 companies visited the campus and presented 147 offers to the students of the batch 2023. Earlier, the average package offered during NIT Manipur placements in 2022 stood at INR 9.7 LPA . The top recruiters of NIT Manipur placements in 2023 included Amazon, Discovery, EDFORA, Infoedge, Veritas , etc.

.

mess: mess food is average and recently when we tried it has im...

reviews.review_text: Our college provides good education. Hostels are great. There are two boys' hostels and two girls' hostels on campus. In every hostel, you will get free facilities. They will guide you whenever you need help. You can also consult your teachers with your doubts.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Sikkim Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: The faculty teaching system is good and understanding.

content.Placements: The college offers a good number of placement opportunities for postgraduate and undergraduate students. Students become eligible for their placements from the fifth semester (undergraduate) and the third semester (postgraduate). The average package is around 6 LPA per annum, and the highest package received was 10 LPA. Companies that visit for placements are Cipla, Microsoft, Unacademy, and many more.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is very well-maintained. The hostel room is fully furnished and properly ventilated. The wardens are very friendly. The hostel's mess food quality is very good and is cooked in a clean environment. The college staff is well-trained, and hostel discipline is very well maintained. The hostel has a common room with an LCD TV. The hostel also provides 24-hour water and power supply.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Climate of Ravangla, Sikkim, is very pleasant.

content.Placements: Every year, the placement cell provides various job opportunities to students by welcoming various companies and industries for the recruitment of deserving students. The average annual package ranges from 2.5-4 Lacs per year. However, in case you don't wanna get into the job you can pursue higher studies in the foreign countries as well.
content.Infrastructure: As NIT Sikkim is still operating from a temporary campus, hostel facilities are not as per the other NITs. Students are forced to live in 5-bedded sharing rooms, where 5 tables, 5 chairs, 5 almirahs, and 5 beds are provided for each student, but it becomes very tough to follow the individual routine. Mess food quality is poor, and the only reason institute states is that Ravangala is a very remote location.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: National institute of technology Sikkim.

content.Placements: There are very good placements and internship opportunities at the college, especially compared to the past 4 years. Over 70% of students are placed through campus recruiting, and there are many campus recruitment drives.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, but compared to other college campuses, it is very small. However, for this region, having this many resources is very good. The campus is beautiful, with a view of Mount Kanchenjunga.
content.Faculty: The faculty is very good. They are interactive and friendly with students. Many faculty members guide students in every situation and are approachable. There are also faculty members with whom students can share their personal problems.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: NIT Sikkim Review on different aspects

content.Placements: If you are capable enough, you'll be getting decent placements. Overall statistics fall about 80% every year with an average package of 9-10 LPA, including 90-95% for CSE, ECE, and 80-85% for core branches like EEE, ME, CE. Some major recruiters are CDAC, CDOT, BEL, NVIDIA, L&T, VEDANTA, GENPACT, DELOITTE, IBM, SLB, HCLTech, and many others as well.
content.Infrastructure: Operating from its temporary campus at a very remote location of Ravangla, it has seen some advancements in the recent financial year, but the thing that will be problematic is sharing with 5-bedded rooms, so it will be very much tough for you to follow your own routine or studies. But excluding this hostel facility, the rest of the facilities are okay, type. Classrooms are well equipped with smart boards, and labs are also well equipped.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the placements of this college.

content.Placements: 80 percent of the students in mechanical engineering department got placement; the highest package was 17 LPA and the lowest package was 5.6 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Mahindra, Bajaj, Maruti, TVS, Deloitte, etc. About 100 percent of students get internships, and 60% are paid internships, and in placement, most of the roles offered are GET.
content.Infrastructure: NIT Sikkim has a temporary campus but the facilities and infrastructure are good. 24*7 wi-fi and electricity are there and all types of labs are present. Most of the labs are open at night as well, so you can work at night as well. The quality of food is average.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty teaching system is good and understanding.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is very well-maintained. The hostel room is fully furnished and properly ventilated. The wardens are very friendly. The hostel's mess food quality is very good and is cooked in a clean environment. The college staff is well-trained, and hostel discipline is very well maintained. The hostel has a common room with an LCD TV. The hostel also provides 24-hour water and power supply.

reviews.review_heading: Climate of Ravangla, Sikkim, is very pleasant.
reviews.review_text: As NIT Sikkim is still operating from a temporary campus, hostel facilities are not as per the other NITs. Students are forced to live in 5-bedded sharing rooms, where 5 tables,  5 chairs,  5 almirahs, and 5 beds are provided for each student, but it becomes very tough to follow the individual routine. Mess food quality is poor, and the only reason institute states is that Ravangala is a very remote location.

reviews.review_heading: National institute of technology Sikkim.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, but compared to other college campuses, it is very small. However, for this region, having this many resources is very good. The campus is beautiful, with a view of Mount Kanchenjunga.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Sikkim Review on different aspects
reviews.review_text: Operating from its temporary campus at a very remote location of Ravangla, it has seen some advancements in the recent financial year, but the thing that will be problematic is sharing with 5-bedded rooms, so it will be very much tough for you to follow your own routine or studies. But excluding this hostel facility, the rest of the facilities are okay, type. Classrooms are well equipped with smart boards, and labs are also well equipped.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the placements of this college.
reviews.review_text: NIT Sikkim has a temporary campus but the facilities and infrastructure are good. 24*7 wi-fi and electricity are there and all types of labs are present. Most of the labs are open at night as well, so you can work at night as well. The quality of food is average.

reviews.review_heading: College Experience in NIT Sikkim.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are available in abundance irrespective of the fact that our college currently has a temporary campus. The instruments and machines are available for every department. The quality of facilities is also quite good. We have a sports committee for managing sports activities.

reviews.review_heading: Completely satisfied with faculty and campus life.
reviews.review_text: When comparing the infrastructure of other NITs with NIT Sikkim, it's quite disappointing because NIT Sikkim currently operates from its temporary campus at Ravangla. Despite the temporary campus, it boasts a great location surrounded by mountains and lush greenery. Everything is available on campus except for the hostel for first-year students. Yes, first-year students have to stay outside the campus in Ravangla city. The college provides both bus services and hostels for first-year students. A...

reviews.review_heading: We have good placement. Good companies are visiting like C-DAC, C-DOT, BEL,etc.
reviews.review_text: Here, facilities are not as per our expectations as NITs should have. There are lots of restrictions on Wi-Fi. We can't watch many YouTube videos. Here, the food quality is very low. Due to the remote area, other facilities are also not good. Teachers rarely motivate us for sports. And if students organise sports, then only we get a chance to play. And once a week, we celebrate Sports Day.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good and beautiful college.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides average facilities. We have a good Wi-Fi connection. The power supply is not good. Power cuts frequently on campus. The hostel is not much good. The food served in the mess is not much good. Around five students can share each hostel room.

reviews.review_heading: You will not be satisfied by campus life but it's okay because you get good placement here.
reviews.review_text: National Institute of Technology Sikkim doesn't have its permanent campus till yet. So, we are only having 1 cricket ground which frequently use as a football ground / Physical training ground / multipurpose ground. Hostels are good but don't have fan and quality of food in mess is awful.

reviews.review_heading: Improvements are needed.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the whole campus. Labs are bad in terms of instruments and infrastructure, however it is expected as it is a place in the high mountains of South Sikkim. Hostel in the campus is good and its food is average. Medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: The college lacks opportunities and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college is located in a very remote location. The climate is always cold and rainy. Only a limited number of classrooms are available in our college. Not much scope for sports and games. Badminton, table tennis, football, and cricket are often played. Library has limited number of books. So students need to share it.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, placements are amazing here.
reviews.review_text: There are good facilities in our hostel, and 24x7 high-speed Wi-Fi is available. There is a good library and also very good labs and classrooms. In NIT Sikkim, classrooms are also amazing. The hostel is very good, and the quality of food served is awesome. I am also a mess in charge here. Medical facilities are a little bit and not good because of a hill area. There are many indoor games and sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is good in this college.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available like gym, playground, library, and Wi-Fi also and currently it is operated under temporary campus but the permanent campus is under construction and will be completed within 3-4 years. The food quality is good, students will get 5 days non-vegetarian here, and there is an ambulance van on the campus for any emergency.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Sikkim - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: It has all the resources available that an NIT should have, despite a newly established NIT. It has proposed a permanent campus in Khamdong East Sikkim. It will take at least 3-4 years to get shifted to its permanent campus. There is good Wi-Fi on campus. It has good classrooms and library.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Uttarakhand Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied by the infrastructure, Cse have good placement, but campus life is poor.

content.Placements: Placements here at NIT Uttarakhand are quite good for CSE and ECE. Even the highest package recently was received by an ECE student. The overall package is 18-20 LPA for CSE companies. Companies like Accenture and Cognizant visit the campus. Also, NVIDIA and Intel , companies like Microsoft and Google, are rare, but overall placement is good for CSE and ECE. Other branches have a low placement rate.
content.Infrastructure: There is no permanent campus of this college. Yes, there is one main building which has a mess boys hostel and classrooms which we call lecture halls. There is no AC , even the library is not maintained properly. There is no sports facility here. Even the school grounds are bigger. The canteen is not available and the Wi-Fi is average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: If you love mountains, valleys and spritual temples you should take it.

content.Placements: In Electronics and Communication its around 70-80% get placed who were eligible. Highest package is 25lakh this and overall its around 40-50lakh. Top recruiting companies are Google, amazon, Accenture, Optym, Global Foundries, Samsung E&A, Samsung R&D, BEL, etc. Associate Knowledge person, Semiconductor Engineer, Software Engineer SDE-1
content.Infrastructure: Wifi and lan connectivity is very fast around (10-40Mb/s). Labs are good enough and equipped with latest machinery, devices and latest version software for RTL design ,TCAD and Cadence. Latest computers with high speed processors. Classrooms are small but equipped with AC, fans and Projectors. Hostels are modern design newly build with 24/7 high speed lan, hot water and modern almiras. Each room have separate balcony. Mess food is average not that good. Medicals facility is fair. Games are average. There is only one canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Pros and cons of taking admission in NIT Uttarakhand.

content.Placements: More than 50 percent of students were placed each year. The highest package is 24 lakhs per annum and the lowest package is 10 lakhs per annum. Samsung, BEL. I don't know much about the internship statistics. Right now, I am in the 2nd year, 3rd semester. I also don't know about the roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our department is very good; all things are available. There is Wi-Fi availability. The infrastructure of our college is not so good because we are living in a temporary campus and our permanent campus is still under construction. Mess food is average. There is no canteen inside the college. Medical facilities are good and sports and games are also good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: College doesn't have its own infrastructure, but it has good academics and bad mess food.

content.Placements: I am a CSE student, and almost 90% of the students got placements. The average package in CSE is 12-13 lakhs per annum, and the lowest average package is somewhere around 8 lakhs per annum. I don't know which companies the students are placed in, but companies quite often visit the college.
content.Infrastructure: The faculties are good and younger in age. The infrastructure is under construction. Students are quite competitive. Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are quite good. The library isn't that good; it's very small. The canteen is also unsatisfactory and small in size, and nowadays, it's not in operation as well.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied with the college.

content.Placements: Approx. 60 to 70 percent of students got placed last year in the civil engineering branch and this ratio is the same as for previous years also. 6 to 10 lakh per annum is the range of the package that is offered every year. Top recruiting companies are TCS and L&T. There is a very low percentage of getting an internship in civil engineering.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in each hostel and labs are small but overall well structured. The same is true for the classroom and there is no good library. The quality of hostels is better, but food quality can be changed by some efforts. No canteen is there. Medical facility is average. Sports and games are very few.

NIT Uttarakhand admissionto the UG and PG courses involves an application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list, and counselling. Aspirants have to go through each admission stage for seat allotment. Candidates can register online for admission to their preferred course. The admission process at NIT Uttarakhand is as per the steps below:
1. Application Process

Candidates who wish to receive admission toNIT Uttarakhandmust appear for the respective entrance exam such as JEE Main for BTech. Shortlisted students for each programme also have to go through a counselling round. Whereas, PhD applicants must directly through the official college website (https://nituk.ac.in/admissions).
2. NIT Uttarakhand Selection Rounds 2025

NIT Uttarakhand selects candidates based on a valid JEE Main score for BTech courses. Candidates are further allotted seats through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly, for PhD admission, candidates are shortlisted for written tests based on required qualifications (GATE/NET/SET qualified). The qualified candidates are called for personal interviews.
3. Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

Once the exams are over,NIT Uttarakhand cutofffor various courses are released by the respective counselling bodies. The institute will release the course-wise merit list for merit-based courses on its official website. As per the merit list, candidates are called for counselling for seat allotment. Shortlisted candidates must then pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

paragraphs: The placement drive of 2025 saw 59 job offers released to the students of BTech and MTech courses. Out of 59, 56 offers were released to the BTech students, while 3 offers were offered to the students of the MTech batch. For BTech, the highest salary package offered was INR 12.5 LPA , while the average package stood at INR 8.03 LPA . Additionally, for the MTech batch, the highest package stood at INR 9 LPA. For the same course, the average offered was INR 7.33 LPA. Top recruiters who visited during the placement drive included Nexturn, Samsung, Publicis Sapient, Oracle, Adobe, Lowe's, Google, Accenture, etc.

During the 2024 placement drive, the highest package offered was INR 32 LPA, while the average salary package stood at INR 13.57 LPA for BTech in CSE. Some of the top recruiters were Publicis Sapient and ThoughtSpot, among others.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied by the infrastructure, Cse have good placement, but campus life is poor.
reviews.review_text: There is no permanent campus of this college. Yes, there is one main building which has a mess boys hostel and classrooms which we call lecture halls. There is no AC , even the library is not maintained properly. There is no sports facility here. Even the school grounds are bigger. The canteen is not available and the Wi-Fi is average.

reviews.review_heading: If you love mountains, valleys and spritual temples you should take it.
reviews.review_text: Wifi and lan connectivity is very fast around (10-40Mb/s). Labs are good enough and equipped with latest machinery, devices and latest version software for RTL design ,TCAD and Cadence. Latest computers with high speed processors. Classrooms are small but equipped with AC, fans and Projectors. Hostels are modern design newly build with 24/7 high speed lan, hot water and modern almiras. Each room have separate balcony. Mess food is average not that good. Medicals facility is fair. Games are avera...

reviews.review_heading: Pros and cons of taking admission in NIT Uttarakhand.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our department is very good; all things are available. There is Wi-Fi availability. The infrastructure of our college is not so good because we are living in a temporary campus and our permanent campus is still under construction. Mess food is average. There is no canteen inside the college. Medical facilities are good and sports and games are also good.

reviews.review_heading: College doesn't have its own infrastructure, but it has good academics and bad mess food.
reviews.review_text: The faculties are good and younger in age. The infrastructure is under construction. Students are quite competitive. Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are quite good. The library isn't that good; it's very small. The canteen is also unsatisfactory and small in size, and nowadays, it's not in operation as well.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi is available in each hostel and labs are small but overall well structured. The same is true for the classroom and there is no good library.
The quality of hostels is better, but food quality can be changed by some efforts. 
No canteen is there.
Medical facility is average.
Sports and games are very few.

reviews.review_heading: The college infrastructure is not good, but professors are good and helpful.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good; it is on lease, and only a small area is provided. Wi-Fi is in good condition, labs are also good, but the library is not that great, and classrooms are average. There is no canteen in our college, and the hostel is good, but the mess food is not good. Sports and games are available here.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Uttarakhand review by Rohit.
reviews.review_text: It is obvious we are NITians, and the facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, libraries, etc. are there and they are good too but due to the temporary campus, which means sufficient space, these things get managed there. Space is less there but these get managed.

reviews.review_heading: My college review in my words.
reviews.review_text: Our college facilities and infrastructure are quite limited as compared to any other NIT because our campus is temporary; our permanent campus is under construction, but all the basic facilities are provided by the college, like medical, canteen, sports, hostel, and so on.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review for my juniors.
reviews.review_text: The condition of the classrooms is not too good but every classroom has projectors and many of them have air conditioning. Labs are good and Wi-Fi speed is good but with LAN it gives high-speed. Students can issue books from library at any time for their respective semester and return them at the end of the semester. Quality of the mess food is not too good but it is okay. Games and sports are also played like football, cricket, volleyball, table tennis, and many more. Different tournaments are ...

reviews.review_heading: GATE Specials NIT Uttarakhand.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure with good quality tables, wardrobes, windows, chairs, but less maintenance. Good Wi-Fi connectivity, good lab infrastructure, and good classroom conditions. Bad quality food in college. Sometimes, a good and clean environment, good mess, and sports activities.

reviews.review_heading: Best College in Srinagar, Uttarakhand.
reviews.review_text: The labs are decent. The classrooms resemble those of your school, not large lecture halls. There is also a library with a sufficient amount of books. The hostels are good, with three students per room. The canteen's food is average and does not remain open throughout the night. A pool table is available, and there is a gym with basic facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Most reviews are not good because of the campus, I agree, but other facilities are almost good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and Infrastructure, like the classrooms, are basically in a temporary campus, but it is quite okay. There is a 24/7 Wi-Fi facility in the hostels, the libraries are open and easily accessible during the daytime. If you speak about the hostels, so the mess, the food is not good, the quality is very regarding. Even after frequent complaints by the students, there is an institute canteen available. Das Institute also has a dispensary, which is accessible 24/7. There is also a sports room...

reviews.review_heading: Life at NIT Uttarakhand .
reviews.review_text: The current NIT Uttarakhand is run on a temporary campus of the government Polytechnic College and one ITI campus at Srinagar, Uttarakhand. A permanent campus is under construction in a place known as Sumari, which is nearby Srinagar. Hostels are available for both boys and girls in the undergrad program. The facilities include bedrooms with 3 beds and tables, one social gathering area and a mess. The food is just eatable.

reviews.review_heading: Good and Decent Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good as the campus is temporary. Our temporary campus is also improving, and construction of our permanent campus is underway. Hostels were quite decent, only for boys. New hostels were also built after 1 year, but for girls, only old hostels are available. Mess food was pathetic.

reviews.review_heading: No campus life, many good places to travel nearby, only road connectivity, and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very poor. Clogged washrooms; some rooms had leaking roofs during the rainy season. Wi-Fi facilities are good 24/7, the library is very small, the labs are average, and the and the classrooms are like school classrooms. Our coaching classes had better classrooms and projectors. The quality of food is not up to par. We found larvae in our food and also in our chairs. reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Really good overall development of student and good placements.

review_content.Placements: I am still in first semester, first year, but it has been assured that in CS department the placement is almost 100 percent, and the highest package is around 42 LPA for foreign placement and 38 LPA for domestic placement. Placement training is very good according to seniors.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are very neat and well maintained. Same applies to campus and washrooms. Teachers use smart board to interact with class and teach. Library and Labs are very accessible and make everything easy for students. Sports department are very good and facilities are also amazing.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Good college for both studies and enjoyment. Placements are good, and you can have a good life.

review_content.Placements: Mostly, 80 percent of the students got placed. The highest package is 33 LPA, and it was a Japanese company. The average package is about 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Capgemini, Infosys, Eurofins, Ancko Visteon, and many others. Roles offered in our courses are electronics engineer, VLSI Engineer, and embedded system engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have the best infrastructure that any college can provide, 24-hour library facilities, including a digital library. Wi-Fi access for every student. Best labs, most of the labs are developed by recruiting companies, and classrooms are well-equipped with a digital board for every classroom and good ventilation.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Finally, our college is the best for placements. It provides 100% placements.

review_content.Placements: The average package is 6 LPA, and the maximum packages range from 15-20 LPA and sometimes, above 20 LPA. On the core side, one of the best company that hire students is Capgemini. The percentage of students who got internships from our course is 60%. Companies like SAP, LG, etc., hire students from the college. The top roles offered in our course are chip designer and software developer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Everything is available, like a gym, Wi-Fi, library, labs, and classrooms. The maintenance is very high. The food is excellent. Emergency medical facilities are available. The infrastructure and facilities will help thousands of students make an informed college decision.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: NHCE has a good placement percentage, campus life, and industry exposure.

review_content.Placements: I have just completed my first year, so I do not know much about placement opportunities in the college, but what I have learned from seniors is that the number of students who got placed this year was higher than last year. The highest package is 42.5 LPA, and the lowest package is around 4 LPA. The average package is 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Zscalar, Visa, Flexcar, Hitachi, IBM, Infosys, Capgemini, Cognizant, Deloitte, etc. Nearly 45% of students got internships from my branch in companies like VMware, Société Générale, etc., Top roles offered are full-stack developer, data analyst, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: This is an amazing college for students to explore various opportunities.

review_content.Placements: I am studying computer science with data science. The topmost package for our batch is 25 LPA. Almost 75% of students got an internship offer and are excelling in various companies such as MathCo, Airbus, Nokia, and Rakuten. The top roles given are data analyst and data engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are huge and can accommodate up to 80 to 90 students with smart board facilities and projectors for all uses. The hostel food and the lifestyle are good and well-maintained. They make hygienic food and the all the medical facilities are always available 24 hrs.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Good placements and infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: In our artificial intelligence and machine learning course, about 70% of seniors got placed this year. The highest package in our college this year is 32.7 LPA. The average package is 10 LPA. The minimum package is 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies of our course AIML are Walmart, Cessna, Embassy, Tech Park, Prestige, Infosys, and others as well. In our college, more than 60% of students get paid internships from the artificial intelligence and machine learning course in various companies. Top roles offered in my course are data handling and web development.

paragraphs: New Horizon College course admission to courses is merit or entrance-based. As per the next step, students need to fill an online application form by visiting the official website of New Horizon College. The admission procedure for each course is explained in detail in the information bulletin:
1- New Horizon Application Process

The New Horizon application process is completely online. The application form is a key part of the admission process. Applications with incomplete or false information will not be entertained. Candidates can access the application form through the New Horizon College official website. Aspirants can also download the form for offline submission.
2- Selection

The college selects candidates for admission to BE programme based on their Class 12 or KCET scores. Admission to MBA and MCA courses is bases on MAT, KMAT or PGCET scores of the candidates. The selection for MTech programme is based on PGCET or GATE scores of the aspirants.
Aspirants can also get seat under Management Quota. The college offers admission via Management Quota based on the merit of the candidates.
3- Admission confirmation

Selected candidates are offered seat based on their merit or entrance exam scores. Aspirants need to report at the campus for document verification. Candidates also need to pay the NHCE Bangalore fees to confirm their seat.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Our college has a good and favorable environment for good quality of studying.

content.Placements: This year, the placement rates for students at my college are impressive compared to previous years. I am from the ECE department, and companies are seeking skilled students rather than just those with good CGPAs. VLSI skills require a considerable amount of coding ability, and the focus is on the core domain of the department.
content.Infrastructure: I am a hosteler, and being a hosteler the quality of the room is quite good not much. If we compare it with the other private colleges the infrastructure quality needs to be improved as soon as possible. The size of the rooms is not enough for 2 people.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the things I am getting in my college. Especially for the placements.

content.Placements: In my college, there are ample placement opportunities for Mechanical Department students. Most companies, such as Oil India Limited, L&T, and TCS, recruit here. The average package is between 10 and 12 LPA, which is good for new engineering graduates. All final-year students are actively seeking jobs.
content.Infrastructure: Our departments, library, classrooms, and labs have good infrastructure. The Wi-Fi system offers 24/7 service. Hostel facilities are also decent, and for sports and games, there is a football turf, a volleyball court, and a gymnasium with all the necessary equipment. The mess food is quite okay—not particularly good or bad.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Improvement is required in every aspect.

content.Placements: The minimum placement package starts from 3 LPA and the maximum goes up to 6 LPA as of today, i.e., 03/02/2025. The highest package is around 9 LPA offered by Oil India and other PSUs. The placement packages range from 3 LPA to 9 LPA. About 50% of the students from my course get placed. To be eligible for placements students should not have any active backlogs. The top recruiting companies include Oil India, L&T, Vikas Group, Reliance and others.
content.Infrastructure: The department building is good and there is a Wi-Fi facility along with the library. It has a clean environment both inside and outside. There is no Wi-Fi connection in the labs and classrooms. The infrastructure is average and not very impressive and cleanliness needs to be maintained. This should be addressed by the administration. The mess in the hostel is the worst with no hygiene maintained. The canteen is decent offering a variety of food items including fast food. Sports and games facilities are well equipped with a turf ground, badminton court, basketball court and more.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Strong faculty, Industry- Relevant Curriculum, Vibrant Campus.

content.Placements: 60 percent of students were placed from my department. The highest package offered in my department was 1,200,000 LPA, and the lowest package was 300,000 LPA. The average package was above 400,000 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Tata Projects, L&T, and Vedanta.
content.Infrastructure: Most departments are equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi to ensure seamless internet connectivity for research. Classrooms are typically equipped with multimedia facilities like projectors and smart boards. University libraries usually have a wide range of textbooks.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: NERIST pros and cons. Hidden behind the hills of Northeast.

content.Placements: The placements are average. The average per annum incomes which our college gives range from 3 LPA to 9 LPA. Many known companies do come, like L&T, TATA Projects, Vedanta, OIL India Ltd. Unknown small companies also come for non-technical posts. Otherwise, you can prepare well for GATE and get better placements.
content.Infrastructure: Academic blocks and classroom infrastructure are average. You won't find broken tables and chairs in classrooms. However, hostels are the worst here. Every single room will either have broken windows or broken walls, and some have water leaks too. Even the electricity wiring is very bad; the way they have done the wiring in the hostel is so bad that it can't take heavy loads, and during summer, there is always the problem of electricity overloading. Drinking water supply is very bad, both in the hostel and academic blocks. The tube lights and bulbs we have to buy by ourselves.

faqs.question: Is it easy to get admission in RMK Engineering College?
faqs.answer: Admission to RMK Engineering College is not much easy, especially because it happens purely on merit. While applying for undergraduate courses including B.E. and B.Tech, candidates would have passed 10+2 with at least a 60% aggregate marking in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. There aren't any entrance exams with admissions happening through TNEA counseling. Although the college has a good reputation and competitive placements, the students coming from other states have to apply under management quota, which requires additional fees. So the admission process is not so complicated and inaccessible for eligible candidates.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for RMK Engineering College admission?
faqs.answer: The admission process for the undergraduate programs of RMK Engineering College is conducted through the Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions, commonly known as TNEA. For the academic year 2024, registration commenced on 4th May 2024 and ended on June 4th,  2024. Important dates involved were that of issuing of random number on 7th June 2024 and announcement of rank list on July 12th,  2024. Since it is December 21st,  2024, now the admissions for this academic year have come to a close. Prospective students aiming to apply for the academic year 2025 should expect the timeline to be similar; therefore, applications will likely be up in May 2025. It is also recommended to check the official website of RMK Engineering College and the TNEA portal for any further updates on admission schedules and deadlines.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in 2015, strict faculty, good Food and amenities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Every class, lab, and mess is spacious. Good amount of fans. Very good greenery. Spacious campus. Mess had veg and non-veg separate. Good ventilation in most classrooms. There is a medical room as well. Library is huge and had good AC.

reviews.review_heading: Perfect experience of my college life.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a big infrastructure with a clean and tidy environment, enriched with Wi-Fi access, labs, developed classrooms, and plenty of books in the library. They provide quality facilities such as good food, clean restrooms, quality games and events, and a fantastic atmosphere, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Feeling proud to be a part of my college.
reviews.review_text: Our college has one of the most beautiful campus layouts in our city. Our college has 5 star rating in Food preparation and serving! A very hygienic and clean environment is maintained all over the campus. 24 hour power supply and Water without any disturbance. Well mannered staff and Workers. Quality of Labs with the costliest equipment and a huge library with more than 10000 books. Hostellers are well raised with college food, and they feel their hostel rooms are like their home. Everyone is t...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of their curriculum and good facilities.
reviews.review_text: Generally, Wi-Fi is good at speed in classrooms and library, and labs have very fast Ethernet, the quality of food and hostel is very good, and the food can be rated 4.8/5 stars, while sports periods and medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: R.M.K. Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good in my college. We have the best classrooms and well-equipped labs with all the requirements. We have Wi-Fi available at any place. We have one library with a well-stocked book collection. The hostel facility is available, and hostel nights are very memorable moments. They have a medical clinic.

reviews.review_heading: R.M.K Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: There is beautiful infrastructure in my college. There are nice classrooms, ventilation and washrooms, all of which are very good. We have free classrooms for students to sit and a library available. We have so many canteens and hostels available for long-distance students.

reviews.review_heading: Really good college for growth and development of skills.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are too good and well maintained. Actually, our college is famous for its food. The hostel is well maintained and clean every day by the service staff, and very hygienic in everything. They provide a separate menu each day, both veg and non veg.

reviews.review_heading: A good campus and one of the best choices of my life that I will not regret.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure and much more. I feel very good, especially about their food, which is on point. The hostel is very neat and clean. The food is very good. Biryani on Tuesday with potato chips is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure and placements with supportive faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities were available in our department. Our college provided high-speed Wi-Fi connectivity, well-equipped computer labs with updated systems, and each class had one projector. Mess and canteen provided a variety of food options, and it was very hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: If you are ready to work hard then it's for you.
reviews.review_text: At RMK Engineering College, you can get many opportunities like CAT lab, mech lab, computer lab, etc. The main thing is how you use the facilities that college provides. Be aware of technologies, and the facilities are always available to clear doubts.

reviews.review_heading: The college is eco-friendly with high placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities are good in our college. Campus-wide high-speed Wi-Fi is available, including in academic blocks, hostels, and the library. Students can access online journals, video lectures, and project tools. There are dedicated labs for computer science and electronics engineering courses.

reviews.review_heading: First step to your career.
reviews.review_text: In our classrooms, we have projectors, and the infrastructure is good. The classrooms are good, and the labs are not okay. The library is very good. In our hostels, the quality of food is excellent. The hostels are good and very hygienic. It is a good environment in hostels, and the mess quality is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Students who find happiness in little things can join this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is so clean and fresh. There are many staff members assigned to the cleaning department; especially, washrooms are maintained well. The water facility is good in the hostel. Wi-Fi is available 24/7; we get disturbances only when the weather conditions are not good. The library is the most peaceful spot in our college.

reviews.review_heading: In terms of placements, it is okay, but not for the more skilled people, & the faculty is also mode.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are okay, and the infrastructure is also similar. Every department is different, and resources vary for each of them. The food is nice, but the sports and games facilities are lacking, with very few sports events held yearly, and they don't provide time for practice.

reviews.review_heading: R. M. K. Engineering College is really the best infrastructure college.
reviews.review_text: R. M. K. Engineering College provides good classrooms with air conditioning facilities. There are more civil-related laboratories in this college. The college offers a free Wi-Fi network, and library facilities are also available. The canteen food tastes very good, with a variety of options available, while the hostel food tastes very average. Basketball ground facilities are also present in this college.

paragraphs: As per Shri Mata Vaishno Devi University Engineering and Management NIRF reports 2024, the median package offered during BTech and MBA placements 2023 stood at INR 5.5 LPA and INR 4.41 LPA , respectively. In addition, according to the Architecture NIRF report 2024, the median package offered during BArch placements 2023 stood at INR 2.5 LPA .

Earlier, the University concluded 2022 placements with 455 students placed in leading companies such as Tech Mahindra, Infosys, Accenture, and many others. Out of all, Cognizant emerged as the top recruiter with the highest number of students selected during SMVDU placements 2022.

reviews.review_heading: SMVDU has a scenic campus, supportive faculty, good academics, and improving placements.
reviews.review_text: SMVDU has modern facilities, with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, well-equipped labs, a central library, and digital resources. Hostels are clean with basic amenities, 24X7 internet, and study areas. Mess and canteen serve hygienic food. Medical center, sports complex, gym, and grounds support student health, and recreation is available for development.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The library is the main facility, which is helpful for the students. Wi-Fi facility is available for both students and faculty members. There are several messes and canteens available for different houses. A gymnasium is available for hostel students. Ground available for all the students. University sports games are held among different houses.

reviews.review_heading: College is surrounded by a heaven.
reviews.review_text: The college facilities are very good and well-provided. It also has a good mess facility. The campus spans 450 acres with lush greenery and is surrounded by the beautiful Trikuta mountain ranges, which enhance the beauty of the campus and its surroundings.

reviews.review_heading: SMVDU: Where learning meets nature.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good on the campus, which is 474 acres. The campus has Wi-Fi in all areas, classes, labs, and a central library. The food is also better in SMVDU. There are two girls' and five boys' hostels. It has its central gym for boys and girls. You are provided full medical assistance in the hospital. All the bills are paid by the university. It has all the sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: College surrounded by trikuta hills.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was good. College provided high-speed internet connectivity and smart classes. There was a big library. Classrooms were well organized and equipped with CCTV cameras. Hostel infrastructure was good. But hostel food was not that good. There was a huge sports ground also.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life and excellent campus area.
reviews.review_text: There are high-tech labs and good Wi-Fi connectivity. Projectors are available in classrooms. Library has huge variety of books. Two sharing rooms are available in hostel. 4 badminton courts are available in my hostel. A large mess is available with good quality food. A medical dispensary is available on the campus with ambulance.

reviews.review_heading: In summary, I can say that our college is not as good as IITs but still a good choice for students.
reviews.review_text: There are good facilities and infrastructure in our labs and classrooms, all the appliances are as good as new. Books availability is also good enough in library. Hostel is good but bathroom conditions are so bad. Rooms are clean and we get one single bed with one table and chair along with an almirah.

reviews.review_heading: Affordable college for B.Tech.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. College provides high-speed internet connectivity and smart classes. There is a big library and classrooms are well-organized and equipped with CCTV cameras. Hostel food is not that good but provides variety in food. There is a huge sports ground also.

reviews.review_heading: Detailed review of SMVDU.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our department is not so good. We don't have our department we have to study in the architecture department. In our hostel, rooms are very big and clean but hostels washrooms are so bad even animals can't go there. Mess food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with all facilities, but the hostel infrastructure is not good. Overall, good.
reviews.review_text: In the university, the civil branch has a combined department with architecture, where they provide three classrooms for civil students and some labs. The university also has a one central library and a gym. In the hostel, the university provides all basic necessities, but the only reason they lack is cleanliness, as hostels are not up to that level. The food provided is not good. But the overall experience is good.

reviews.review_heading: An honest and unbiased review of Shri Mata Vaishno Devi University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the campus is quite good. The hostel is also very nice. Rooms are very neat and look more like hotel rooms. The infrastructure of our washrooms is even worse than railway toilets. There is Wi-Fi everywhere. There is a library inside the hostel. You can play badminton. We have a very large ground on our campus where you can play any sport.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are bad, rare fests, great restrictions on girls, not worth it.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are just fine like the hostels are supposed to be. There's Wi-Fi available here but you cannot rely on it, there are frequent shutdowns, apart from that websites like Quora are banned on the university Wi-Fi. Classrooms are fine but you can expect the projectors to not work. Initially, the classes for CSE were held in a lecture theatre which has the facility AC and projectors working there but later on, they were shifted to classrooms. Library is fine, equipped with AC and you can find b...

reviews.review_heading: College and Clubs are inactive with no fest.
reviews.review_text: Rooms are not well-maintained, but the campus looks beautiful, especially at night. The hostel is different for students of different years. The 1st-year hostel is good. All other hostels have a badminton court and a basketball court, which is good and makes our hostel life beautiful.

admission_process.title: Sona College of Technology Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Sona College of Technologyadmission 2025is open for various courses. The institute offers BTech/B.E, M.E/MTech, MBA and MCA courses at the UG and PG level. Apart from the UG and PG courses, the institute offers doctorate courses. The selection criteria are completely entrance-based. To get admitted to SCT, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the institute. The college is affiliated withAnna University. The application process atSona College of Technologyis conducted both online/offline. Read the article to know more aboutSona College of Technologycourse admission2025.

Sona College of Technology course admissionis completely based on entrance exam scores such as TANCET, GATE, MAT etc. The college also acceptsPearson Undergraduate Entrance Examscores for UG courses. Students seeking to apply for any of the courses offered at the institute must fulfil the admission criteria of the desired programme before applying for it. Applicants need to register and appear for the accepted entrance exam before applying for the course. Students can refer to the table below to know about the eligibility and selection criteria criteria atSona College of Technology courses:
Based on the cut-off marks obtained in Class 12
Cut-off mark = 200 (100 for Mathematics and 100 for Physics + Chemistry)
Merit +TNEA counselling
TANCET/CET/GATE
MAT/TANCET/CET
UGC NET or GATE

Sona College of Technology admission processincludes several steps. Students applying for the programmes offered at the college must ensure to satisfy the course-specific admission criteria as per the college's guidelines. The entire application process is in online mode. Below is the step-wiseadmission process of Sona College of Technology:
Step 1: Sona College of Technology Application Process 2025

Interested candidates who fulfil the specified eligibility can visit the official website (https://www.sonatech.ac.in/admission/) of the college to fill out the application form. For PhD application, students must download the form, fill up the form and submit it. Candidates need to select the desired course, pay the application fee and upload the required documents to complete the registration.
Step 2: Sona College of Technology Selection Process

Once the registration is done, the candidates will be shortlisted based on the marks obtained in the entrance/qualifying exams for the respective courses they chose. The college takes into account both academic merit and entrance exam scores to make a merit list of the eligible candidates for each course. Students will be shortlisted by the college based on various parameters, including entrance exams, academic merit) etc. For PhD course admission, students are selected based on UGC NET or GATE.
Step 3: Counselling and Fee Payment

Once the candidates are shortlisted, the college may contact the candidate for counselling. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theSona College of Technology feeto confirm their seats at the college.

overview_faqs.question: Is Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College a known institute?
overview_faqs.answer: It was popularly known Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College, also known as SREC was located at Coimbatore and it had been established in the year 1994. The college had offered the needed quality in the course and had maintained the 95% and above strength of students successfully joining major companies like Infosys, Wipro among other respectable companies. With Under Graduate and Post-graduate degree courses, this engineering institution is accredited under 'A+' grade given by the NAAC for Quality Standard. SREC focuses on practical learning with the collaboration of industries and modern infrastructure, thus very popular among the engineering aspirants in the region. The focus on the development of students further adds a glory to it.

overview_faqs.question: Is Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College a known college/Institute?
overview_faqs.answer: The flagship courses offered at Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College are B.Tech, MBA/PGDM, M.E./M.Tech. review_summary.college_name: Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Really good facilities, infrastructure, and good placements in 2025.

content.Placements: 95% students are placed in my course. The highest package is likely to be 55 LPA for my course, the average package is 20 LPA, and the lowest package is above 7 LPA. The top recruiting company for my course is Capgemini. 85% students got internships in the same company, Capgemini. The top roles offered in my course are Software Developer.
content.Infrastructure: For CSE, we have Wi-Fi facilities in all labs. We have nearly 10 labs specially for CSE, and good library facilities are also available online, to get books anywhere. The hostel facilities are good. Some of my hostel friends told me that there are some drinking water issues, but other things are good. Our college has a food court on campus, and the food is good, no complaints. Our college trustee has their own hospital, so the medical facilities are good in our college and sports and games are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: This college is the safest plan B for any student.

content.Placements: 75% of students got placed. The highest package is 20 LPA, the lowest package is 2 LPA. Capgemini, Accenture, and TCS are the top recruiting companies, but getting a placement is easy. However, the company has told the students that they are not capable enough, and more than 60% of students have been fired within one year.
content.Infrastructure: The library is good. Wi-Fi is provided at selected locations. The hostel is below average with very high fees. Facilities like mess, canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games are good, but you need to find time to utilize these facilities, and the gym is also available, but the equipment is very average.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It has good faculty members with PhD. It has helpful teaching and average placements.

content.Placements: Mostly 72-75% of students got placed in the college. The highest package is 12 LPA and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. A lot of companies visit our campus like Cognizant, Kovai. Co, Accenture. etc. This time, only 78% of students of students get placed. A lot of seniors passed from the college and got placed in good companies and also higher companies like Amazon, Flipkart, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is okay and the food is not good. Students are not satisfied with the college. The food available in the canteen is not that much of good.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it is the best college for the MBA course.

content.Placements: Approximately 82-92% of students participated in this study. The highest package is 29 LPA, the average is around 15-22 LPA, and the lowest is 3-6 LPA. Top recruiters are Flipkart, Snapdeal, Larsen & Toubro, etc. 70-80% of students get internships in many industries. The top jobs offered are financial analyst, operations manager, and more.
content.Infrastructure: The college has well-equipped labs available for all branches. You have to pay for Wi-Fi, as it is not available for students. There are three libraries with all the books, and an excellent cafeteria where students can treat themselves to all kinds of good food. The college provides a bus service, and it plies all over Coimbatore and some places outside Coimbatore.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college for placements.

content.Placements: The top engineering school in Coimbatore was Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College. This college had excellent placement results. In my last year, around 30 firms came to interview on this college campus. The wage packages given by such companies range from 4 LPA to 15 LPA. These interviews on college campuses resulted in placements for almost 97% of students. Well-known businesses include Teach Mahendra, TVS, Hyundai, and TCS. These businesses came to interview on this college campus.
content.Infrastructure: The amenities and infrastructure of Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College were first-rate. This college also has a well-stocked library and more contemporary labs and classrooms. Good hostel amenities were offered by this college. There is a wide selection of cuisine at this campus canteen. There were also other sports facilities on this campus. Traveling was made easier for us by the excellent transmission options this college offered its students. This college also had Wi-Fi facilities.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for B.Tech programme at Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College?
