Facilities like mess, canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games are good, but you need to find time to utilize these facilities, and the gym is also available, but the equipment is very average.

reviews.review_heading: It has good faculty members with PhD. It has helpful teaching and average placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is okay and the food is not good. Students are not satisfied with the college. The food available in the canteen is not that much of good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best college for the MBA course.
reviews.review_text: The college has well-equipped labs available for all branches. You have to pay for Wi-Fi, as it is not available for students. There are three libraries with all the books, and an excellent cafeteria where students can treat themselves to all kinds of good food. The college provides a bus service, and it plies all over Coimbatore and some places outside Coimbatore.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for placements.
reviews.review_text: The amenities and infrastructure of Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College were first-rate. This college also has a well-stocked library and more contemporary labs and classrooms. Good hostel amenities were offered by this college. There is a wide selection of cuisine at this campus canteen. There were also other sports facilities on this campus. Traveling was made easier for us by the excellent transmission options this college offered its students. This college also had Wi-Fi facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College is the best engineering college.
reviews.review_text: Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College's infrastructure facilities are excellent. This college has high-tech modern laboratories. More spacious classrooms. A good library facility is also available at this college. This college provides good hostel facilities for both boys and girls. The hostel food quality is very hygienic. Some sports ground facilities are also available in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Civil engineering in Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: The department is well-equipped with labs and classrooms There is a common and a department library. Wi-Fi is available for free all over the campus including the hostel. Sports and games are conducted in zonal levels. The hostel is fine with proper food.

reviews.review_heading: Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College has good infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College infrastructure and facilities were excellent. More modern classrooms and laboratories and well-stocked library were also there at this college. This college provided good hostel facilities. Variety of foods available for this college canteen. Multiple sports grounds facilities were also there in this college. This college provided good transportation facilities for students, making it convenient for us to travel. Wi-Fi facilities were also there at this colleg...

reviews.review_heading: Extremely happy with many facilities offered by the campus to the societies.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very vibrant. It has highly equipped labs, digital libraries, and Wi-Fi. The hostel is very nice. The hostel food is clean and hygienic. Our campus has a health center. It is available with 24/7 working hours. Sports and games are very important in our college as well as academics.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the academics part. Really good staff but need more cultural activities.
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure is average, but the food is pretty decent and adjustable. It is a completely Wi-Fi-enabled hostel, but the network may buffer sometimes. Otherwise, it's okay. The food can be changed if there's a major complaint from many students. We can raise the issue with the warden and authorities to change the menu.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course/department are free Wi-Fi, high-tech labs, classrooms, libraries, etc. The quality of the facilities in our hostel, the quality of food available in the mess and canteen, medical facilities, and sports and games are all good.

reviews.review_heading: Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College is really the best engineering college.
reviews.review_text: Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College has excellent infrastructure facilities. More spacious classrooms are available, especially many computer laboratories equipped with internet facilities. The library is well-equipped as well. The college's sports ground facilities are also very good. Separate hostel facilities are available for boys and girls, with a variety of food options.

reviews.review_heading: Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College is really the best engineering college.
reviews.review_text: Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College offers more than 20 courses, with ample classroom facilities. Laboratories for civil, mechanical, electrical, and computer engineering are available. The hostel is maintained very cleanly, and the food is good. Medical facilities are also present on campus, along with sports ground facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: We have excellent infrastructure within the campus. There is a strict security system for the college and hostel. We maintain a very healthy and hygienic campus. All the seniors and juniors are very coordinated with us at all times, and they are also very friendly.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is fine except the out-of-town bus facilities, infrastructure, and placement.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very simple, but the facilities have no compromises as they have clean drainage for both the college and hostel. Immediate action is taken if any issue is raised. Labs, classrooms, and libraries are fully ventilated and air-conditioned. Wi-Fi is available throughout the college and hostel. The food is fine, and the snacks provided there are healthy and hygiene-friendly. The college has a health centre with 3 nurses and 1 doctor. Ambulance is also available for the hostel studen...

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I can suggest people to join here because no other college can train this much for placements.

content.Placements: Almost out of 100 percent, from 2026 batch, 75 percent are placed in top MNC companies. The highest package from my course is 19 LPA and the lowest is 3.5 LPA. Almost every person from my department is placed in MNCs like Zoho, Cognizant, Infosys, etc. Nearly 50 percent get internships from my course in companies like Accenture, Cisco, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Classes are neat and clean. Almost every class has Wi-Fi. Labs are maintained in a clean way and the staff are friendly. We can access the library anytime. In the hostel room, 4 can occupy each room and the food is healthy; every day they provide non-veg except Thursday. For sports & games, students can play according to their own interest & talent. Medical facilities are provided immediately; they also have Siddha and Ayurveda.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the college and the experience gained.

content.Placements: Over 80 percent of the students are placed, and the placements are still going on. The lowest package offered is 3.5 LPA, and the highest package offered is 32 LPA. Companies such as Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), LTI Mindtree, Accenture, Zoho, PSIOG, etc. Internship is compulsory for every student in our college. Many got internships from national institutes and many other companies. I have done my internship at the National Institute of Ocean Technology. Roles offered include software developer, data engineer, data scientist, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure provided is very useful. Labs are fully equipped with Wi-Fi and usable systems, especially in our department which has many labs, divided per department. admission_process.title: Sri Sairam Engineering College Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: SSREC Chennai admissionsare both merit and entrance-based. The college considers Class 12 score for BE/ BTech programme whereas, admission to ME/ MTech and MBA is based on entrance-exam.Sri Sairam Engineering Collegeaccepts TANCET and CEETA-PG scores for admission to PG programmes. The college offers courses at UG and PG levels in Engineering and Management streams. Interested candidates can fill out the admission enquiry form available on the college website for more information.

SSREC offers admission to UG courses based on merit in the qualifying exam. The college also considers entrance-exam scores for admission to PG programmes. Below areSri Sairam Engineering College coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
HSc examination

Candidates should also satisfy other eligibility rules as prescribed by theAnna Universityand Directorate of Technical Education, Government of Tamil Nadu, HSc of the vocational stream (vocational groups in Engineering/ Technology) as prescribed by the Government of Tamil Nadu
UG examination of Anna University or equivalent as specified under the qualifications for admissions as per the Tamil Nadu Common Admission

SSREC Chennai admission process includes registration, selection, counselling and seat allotment. Candidates must first check the eligibility criteria to apply for the preferred programme. Below are the steps to get a seat in the college:
Step 1: SSREC Application Process 2025

Candidates seeking admission to the institute must apply for TNEA after completing Class 12 for BE/ BTech. Aspirants need to apply for CEETA-PG and TANCET for MTech and MBA programmes, respectively. Candidates must pay an application fee to register for the exam.
Step 2: Selection

Sri Sairam Engineering College shortlists candidates for BE/ BTech programmes based on Class 12 scores. The institute also accepts TANCET and CEETA-PG scores for admission to MBA and MTech/ ME programmes, respectively.
Step 3: Counselling & Seat Allotment

Once the selection rounds are completed, candidates must participate in TNEA Counselling for BE/ BTech. Aspirants must apply for accepted exam counselling for ME/ MTech and MBA courses. Shortlisted aspirants need to pay theSSREC Chennai feeafter the seat is allotted for final admission.

paragraphs: Students can take a large number of UG, PG, diploma, doctoral, and certificate programs at Tezpur University. ODL (Open and Distance Learning) is another programmes offered by the university. The official site of the university allows interested students to enroll in the desired programme.

Tezpur university admits using different national-level and university-level entrance exams, including CUET-UG, TUEE, and JEE-Main. The eligibility and selection criteria set by the university allow the candidates to apply by completing the application form via the official website of Tezpur University. The Tezpur University admissions are as follows:
1: Tezpur University Application.

In order to join any of the programmes offered in the Tezpur University, the candidates have to fill the application form on the official site of the university with a payment of the necessary application fee to complete the final submission.
2: Selection Criteria of Tezpur University.

The admission at Tezpur university is entirely entrance examination based. The university admits candidates based on a number of national-level and university-level entrance exams, including CUET-UG, TUEE, and JEE-Main to different programmes. Shortlisting will be done to candidates with valid scores in the aforementioned exams in the counselling process.
3: Tezpur University Final Allotment.
The final admission process, i.e. document verification and payment of tuition fee to secure final seat allotment will be done after the completion of the counselling process.

Tezpur University course feesmust be paid once the admission process is completed and later semester-wise. The university's fees range fromINR 4,000toINR 1.3 lakh. The fees include multiple components, such as registration, placement brochure, alumni fees, etc., which candidates must pay during admission. hostel.description:
Tezpur University has 5 boys hostel and 7 girls hostel.All the hostels have basic amenities like water purifiers, common room, recreation room, mess, TV, laundry services, security and surveillance system etc.

The University provides separate accommodation for men and women students and research scholars, having  more  than 3700 capacity. The University also has a married research scholar’s hostel with capacity of accommodating more than 30 married research scholars.

library.description:
Central Library is the focal point of all user community of Tezpur University. The Library caters to the educational and research needs of the academic community and its resources are consulted by scholars from all over the country. Central Library has been started functioning since 1994. At present, the library holds about 83200+ books, 10000+ journals (print + online),online databases, CDs and 7848 back volumes of journals.

Library is a member of e-ShodhSindhu Consortium, DeLCON consortium and DELNET. Library users can access book database, journal database, e-journals, institutional repository, electronic thesis & dissertations and other e-resources from any terminal within the University campus. Library provides reading facility for 365 days in the year.

The library is continuously striving at to adopt the best practices in all endeavours of its activities. The library has fully computerized with the help Libsys software which is an integrated multi-user library management system that supports all in-house operations of the Library.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure, faculty, and environment are good, but I am dissatisfied with the placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, digital boards, a library, a computer center, and labs with a good quantity of instruments are all available, though not in great quantity. reviews.review_text: The amenities are excellent, equipped with all the latest comforts. There is Wi-Fi on the campus and in the hostel rooms. The hostel offers great rooms with high-quality timber furnishings and beautiful paintings. There are also good computer labs. In Assam, having good transportation is essential, and the college provides that. Both North Indian and South Indian food at the canteen, and both are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: It is not as bad as people might think.

All things considered, the buildings are kept up nicely and are convenient for students to access.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: NIE Mysore is the best place to study. It is really worth our time and effort.

content.Placements: There are 180 students in our batch, and out of that, 80% of students get placed which means 144 students got placed. The highest package offered is 12 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. The average package is 5 LPA. Benz, Bosch, and Siemens Technology are the top recruiting companies for our course. 70% of students got internships in various companies like Toyota, TVS, and Mypol. Top roles offered are HVAC engineer and plant manager.
content.Infrastructure: The mechanical department has the best lab facilities not only in our college but in the entire state. Students who are willing to do research work in the mechanical field should opt for NIE Mysore without hesitation. The quality of the food served in the NIE boys' hostel is top-notch. If students are from North India or South India, they can easily adjust to our hostel food. The food is hygienically prepared and very delicious. The ground available to play sports is not that much big. It has one basketball court, one handball court, and some space for playing cricket.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2028

paragraphs: NIE Mysore admission processincludes a series of steps for UG and PG courses. Below is the steps to get admission to NIE Mysore:
Step 1: NIE Mysore Application Process 2025

The mode of application is online for all courses. NIE Mysore admission to MCA and MTech programmes is through the Karnataka PGCET conducted by the Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA). Candidates need to register for entrance exams like KCET or COMEDK-UCET for BE admission. For Management Quota, registration will be done on the official website of the institute.
Step 2: Selection

NIE Mysore shortlists candidates for BE, MTech and MCA courses based on the entrance exam. For BE, candidates can apply for admission through KCET or COMEDK-UGET score. MTech admission will be based on Karnataka PGCET or GATE score.
Step 3: Cutoff
Candidates must score equal or above the cutoff rank to get admission to NIE Mysore courses. The cutoffs are released by entrance exam conducting body, based on which admission is granted.
Step 4: Counselling & Seat Allotment

Once the selection process is over, candidates must come with the specified documents for verification. Seats will be allotted to candidates based on their cutoff ranks. Selected aspirants must pay the course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

Application for admission to the MTech course is available on its official website. Candidates willing to apply can send the duly filled form through email to admissionsTop 10 Engineering Colleges in Hyderabadvjiet.in or directly submit the application at D-519, D Block, VNRVJIET. Admissions to VNRVJIET courses are entrance-based and done according to the guidelines provided by the Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TSCHE).

For VNR VJIET Category B admissions, candidates are required to have a valid scorecard of TSEAMCET-2025 for BTech and TSPGECET-2025 for MTech. The table mentioned below shows the eligibility criteria and selection criteria forVNR VJIET courses:

VNR VJIET offers admission to undergraduate and postgraduate Engineering and Technology courses under management quota, commonly known as VNR VJIET Category B admissions. The VNR VJIET Admissions are based on the performance of the candidate in the entrance exam and the institute follows the admission guidelines provided by the Telangana State Council of Higher Education. The VNR Admission process is a multi-step process starting with the application, students are required to go through the course-specific entrance exam. For admission to the BTech course, candidates are required to appear for either TSEAMCET or JEE exam and for MTech admissions, VNR VJIET accepts TSPGECET rank. The detailed VNR VJIET B category admission process is mentioned below:
VNRVJIET Application Process 2025

The VNR Application for BTech and MTech courses is made available on the official website. Candidates have to email the duly filled form to admissions2025@vnrvjiet.in or directly submit the application at D-519, D Block, VNRVJIET within the stipulated time. Candidates must check the eligibility criteria before applying.
VNRVJIET Selection Criteria and Cutoff Release 2025

Admission to VNRVJIET courses is entrance-based. Candidates seeking admission to BTech must have a valid TSEAMCET or JEE scorecard and for MTech admissions, the institute accepts TSPGECET Rank card. VNR VJIET releases the cutoff for both entrance exams on its official website.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good college with learning opportunities and placements.
reviews.review_text: The electronics and communication engineering department has well-maintained laboratories with sufficient systems and updated software/tools relevant to the course. Classrooms are spacious and clean. Mess and canteen facilities provide hygienic food. The college provides basic medical facilities, including first aid. The college provides indoor games (carrom, chess, table tennis) and outdoor sports (volleyball, badminton, basketball).

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good, but the faculty needs to improve its teaching skills.
reviews.review_text: Good library and facilities, they allow students up to 8:00 PM, from 8:00 AM, which is useful for the students who are preparing for the competitive exams. Each branch has a separate library and 1 common library for all branches. The college is NAAC-accredited.

reviews.review_heading: Good peers and facilities, but limited campus life.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi works only within blocks. Coming to the computer labs, the specs of some systems are too poor. The library has to be the best thing, it has lots of resources, Wi-Fi, and charging ports, well maintained. Classrooms are digital and have charging ports for each bench ( only for CSE/allied Block ). The boys' hostel at Pragati Nagar has better food, gym, and medical facilities than bachupally hostel. Pragati Nagar hostel has great free space, ground, and stationery.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good college for learning and career growth.
reviews.review_text: College has well-maintained classrooms with good Wi-Fi support, properly equipped labs, and a decently maintained library. Hostel facilities are satisfactory, with clean rooms and average food quality. Sports, medical facilities, and canteen are adequate.

reviews.review_heading: It's a crazy college where you can find best environment for personal and professional development.
reviews.review_text: We have a vast college ground where we can play each and every game and have fun. We have a huge central library in C block, 1st floor, and individual libraries on each floor, designed for each course separately. We have well-equipped labs and Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: Our college have good faculties and placements are also available. We have good infrastructure..
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is nice, they are developing it again. Wi-Fi is available for every class, a lot of food is available in the canteen and mess also has a good taste. There is a sports complex where we have sports clubs for different games and sports tournaments are also conducted.

reviews.review_heading: It has good academics, placements, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the campus is very good compared to other colleges. Here, there is a good hostel facility so that everyone can stay without any worries.

reviews.review_heading: It is good for placements and career.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of our college are awesome. They include Wi-Fi, lab instruments with high quality, neat classrooms, peaceful and insightful library. The quality of the facilities in our college is awesome. The quality of food that is available in mess is good.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is helpful, and placements are good. The infrastructure is wonderful.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available. The Wi-Fi gets slow due to a large number of students actively using it. The library is good and well-maintained. Every book is available, and if a book is not available, we can request it. If it is useful for students, they provide it immediately.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college offers a balanced experience for students.
reviews.review_text: Overall, the infrastructure is solid, with a green and clean campus. It also has a good academic and sports facilities, and reasonably comfortable hostels. Wi-Fi and mess consistency, along with a few maintenance issues, prevent it from feeling like a 5-star campus. It justifies a 4-star rating from students.

reviews.review_heading: Good academics, supportive faculty, strong placements, and a balanced campus life.
reviews.review_text: The department has well-maintained classrooms with projectors, Wi-Fi connectivity, and properly equipped laboratories. It support practical learning. The central library is spacious and well-stocked with textbooks, journals, and digital resources. It provides a good study environment. Hostel facilities are decent, with clean rooms. Along with a regular maintenance and good security. The mess food quality is average but hygienic, while the canteen offers affordable additional options. Basic medic...

reviews.review_heading: VNRVJIET is perfect for technical and personal growth.
reviews.review_text: Our department of artificial intelligence and data science has excellent infrastructure. Classrooms are equipped with smart board and projectors. Computer labs have high-speed internet connections and updated systems. The hostel rooms are maintained clean and hygienic. Facilities are decent.

reviews.review_heading: VNRVJIET college is satisfied because of infrastructure, placements, canteen, and friends.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very good, with full of greenery, very strong Wi-Fi across the college, and department-wise laboratory and one large central laboratory. Our college has a very good canteen, gym, sports complex, medical center, and hostel accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: Success beyond VNR VJIET.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure available in my college is very good, with better Wi-Fi connectivity, labs with excellent equipment, classrooms with better benches, fans, and lights. Most importantly, the facility provided by the college is the library, which stays open until 8 PM, helping many students prepare for various competitive exams.

reviews.review_heading: My forced unanimous college.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is well designed and feels aesthetic, bringing back the old mid-journey style with pleasant trees and buses with some God idols decorated and maintained at a top-notch level. Wi-Fi is a bit diverse, labs have holders and experiential new models too, classrooms are neat, good food, good facilities, and accommodation.

content.Placements: In my course, around 80% of students have been placed until now (January 2026). Major recruiters are Darwinbox and Eightfold. AI and Evernorth for our college. faqs.question: Can I join Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology without JEE?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can join Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology (VSSUT) without JEE.There are two ways to join VSSUT without JEE:Through the OJEE:VSSUT accepts OJEE scores for admission to its B.Tech program. The OJEE is a state-level entrance exam conducted by the Government of Odisha for admission to engineering and technology programs in the state.Through lateral entry:VSSUT offers lateral entry admission to its B.Tech programme for students who have completed a Diploma in engineering and technology from a recognised institution.To be eligible for lateral entry admission to VSSUT, you must have passed a Diploma in engineering and technology with a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate (55% marks for SC/ST/OBC candidates).

faqs.question: Can I get admission in VSSUT for B.Sc with 60% in Class 12th?

The top recruiters of Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology in 2025 included Digital Green, Amazon, JP Morgan, UBS, Maruti Suzuki, Cummins India, Intellipaat, Aditya Birla, etc .

overview_faqs.answer: Velagapudi Ramakrishna Siddhartha Engineering College is a reputed institute for B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, MCA. Students can opt these programs to pursue their career in Engineering, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software. Institute has trained & experienced faculty who deliver these programs. Velagapudi Ramakrishna Siddhartha Engineering College has a review rating of 4.4 on the basis of reviews by students. review_summary.college_name: VR Siddhartha Engineering College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placements, supportive faculty members, and a peaceful environment.

content.Placements: 95 percent of students got placed. The highest package offered is 52.6 LPA, and the average package is 4.5 LPA. The least package is 3 LPA. Recruiting companies are Amazon, Cisco, Wipro, TCS, Deloitte, HSBC, PWC, and Flipkart. Almost all students who have good skills got internships. Roles offered are solution architect, quality analyst, developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Department facilities are good. Classrooms and labs are provided with Wi-Fi and AC. Our college has a central library where we can get any books. Coming to college, the food is good. Medical facilities are available. Every Wednesday, the doctor comes. We can play outdoor games as the ground is available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with IT department. It has good facilities.

content.Placements: The 2025 batch placement is very strong. About 85% of students getting placed through campus placements. The average package offered is 3.5 LPA. The lowest package is 2.5 LPA, and the highest package is 35 LPA. Top companies like Microsoft, Cognizant, Accenture, and TCS visit the campus and offer software roles.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the course is decent. Wi-Fi is available. The library has all the required books. Hostel facilities are average, and the mess food quality is also average. The canteen prices are high. I do not see medical facilities during my college days. Sports facilities are available but are poorly maintained.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: VR Siddhartha College of Engineering and Technology provides many courses to students.

content.Placements: In Mechanical, we get companies like Tech Mahindra, TCS, Zomato, and Swiggy that offer jobs with a minimum package. Some students in our college participate in hackathons, which help them get internships at big MNC companies. They provide many opportunities to the students.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good. The quality of lab materials and classroom facilities are excellent. They provide certain competitions for students to improve their sportsmanship qualities. There are ground facilities for students to play cricket.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I absolutely love this college.

content.Placements: 60 to 70% of students get placed in our course. The highest package is about 50 LPA. The lowest package is about 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies in our course include Medha Servo, Hyundai, TCS, etc. Many students get internships in top companies. Top roles offered in our course include graduate engineer, R&D, design engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure in our department are very good. Wi-Fi and classrooms are good. A well-stocked library is available. The quality of facilities in our hostel is good. Hostel food is also good. Canteen food is also good. Medical facilities, sports, and games are also available in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of Velagapudi Ramakrishna Siddhartha Engineering College.

content.Placements: 85% of students got the placements in our college through campus interviews. The highest package for the last year is 44 LPA. The highest is from the AIML branch, not the IT branch. Mostly every year, the highest package is from CSE students. And the average package is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Infosys, and Amazon. We have also provided internships from the second year onwards. Our college provides good skills.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in our college are very good. Our college is a university, so all exams and curriculum are designed by their own decisions. Our college is one of the best colleges in Vijayawada. The placements are also very good in our college. Classrooms are very good in our college. Good benches and digital boards are available in our college. Wi-Fi is available in our college at all times. Hostels are also very good in our college; the food is also very good.

admission_overview.title: VELS University Admission Overview 2026
admission_overview.description: VELS University admission is both entrance and merit-based. The university conducts its own VELS Scholarship Admission Test (V-SAT) to provide scholarship admission to 60+ UG courses. Additionally, the university also accepts national-level entrance exams like CAT, MAT, XAT, GATE, etc., for admission to MBA and MTech courses, respectively. VELS University offers courses at UG, PG and PhD levels through different schools. The courses are offered in multiple streams like Engineering, Management, Science, Commerce, etc. VELS University admission begins with online registration. Read on the following article to know more details about VELS University course admission.

paragraphs: VELS University admission involves application, selection, and admission confirmation. The admission criteria begin with the release of the application form. Check below the step-wiseVELS University admission process:
Application Process
Students can apply online directly through the official application portal of VELS University.
Selection Rounds

VELS University admission 2026 is purely merit-based and is determined by the marks obtained in the 12th standard for the respective courses. However, for law courses, the university also conducts a personal interview as part of the selection process. The university conducts its ownVELS Scholarship Admission Test(V-SAT) to provide scholarship admission to 60+ UG courses. Further, direct admission is offered to BSc and MSc courses based on candidates' scores obtained in the last qualifying exams.
Final Admission
After the completion of all the selection rounds, the selected students may pay a certain amount of course fee to confirm admission.

faqs.question: Will I get a fee refund if I cancel my LLM admission from VELS University?
faqs.answer: Yes, VELS University does provide a refund in case of withdrawal of admission. However, the refund is subject to fulfillment of certain conditions. Listed below are the guidelines to be followed as per the fee refund policy of the university: If students apply for cancellation prior to the commencement of classes, then they are entitled to a refund of the tuition fees. In such a case, registration and admission fees are not refundable. If a student discontinues in the middle of a course, he/she shall be required to pay the tuition fee for the remaining period of the programme.

It has been seen that in the 'Pharmacy' category, the institute's ranks have shown a decreasing trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2024, VELS University fell 17 ranks to #64 rank in the 'Pharmacy' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.

hostel_campus.college_name: VELS University Chennai Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description:
VISTAS offers residential accommodation for more than 1,000 students within the campus premises. The University houses Ten hostels (AC and NON AC Hostels) 5 Boys Hostel, 3 Girls Hostel a NRI Hostel and an International Students’ Hostel — providing a safe, inclusive, and multicultural living environment.
Rooms are available on a shared basis (2 to 4occupants) with all essential amenities, including air-conditioned options. The hostels have spacious dining halls serving multi-cuisine meals (both vegetarian and non-vegetarian) prepared in hygienic conditions.

library.description:
VELS Institute of Science, Technology and Advanced Studies has a fully automated central library with a seating capacity of 500 persons and follows Open Access System. The library has a collection of 114305 books, 137717 e-books, and 10032 back volumes. It has the subscription of more than 359 Periodicals (National & International), more than 12381 e-journals, 4106 dissertations, 4849 audio-visual resources.
It also facilitates access to e-journals from IEEE/IEL, ASME, ASCE, EBSCO, ProQuest, BENTHAM Science Pharmacy, Micromedex’s Drugdex System, Inventi Online, Nature Online, Law finder, NPTEL etc.
The library is also an associate member of Madras Library Network (MALIBNET) and Institutional member British Council Library.

paragraphs: Check below the detailed steps forVignan’s Foundation for Science, Technology & Research admission process:-
1. Application

The application process for Vignans Foundation for Science, Technology and Research is conducted in an online mode. Candidates can apply online on the college's official website and register for their desired courses. Along with that, they must submit the important documents and an application fee to finalise the application process.
2. Selection Rounds

Vignan's Foundation for Science, Technology and Research admission is primarily entrance-based for UG, PG, and PhD courses. For the BTech course the aspiring candidates need EAMCET and to be selected for the MTech programme, the candidates need to have a TS PGECET score. Similarly, they must qualify for admission in rest of the courses. Further, based on the application and entrance exam scores, candidates will be shortlisted.
3.Final Admission

After the completion of all the rounds, candidates will be notified about their selection. The selected candidates must pay the registration fee along with theVignan’s Foundation for Science, Technology & Research fee. Further, they must also submit a photocopy of all the documents as proof at the time of admission.

Visvesvaraya Technological University has a multi- admission process. The admission may vary as per the affiliated colleges/constituents. Find below the common admission procedure as per VTU's admission guidelines:
1: Application process

students must visit the official website and select the programme they want to apply to. The application process requires students to fill out the online application form with all the required details and attach all relevant documents and certificates.
2: Interview, entrance exam, and GP

students' application forms will be scrutinised and selection will be made based on the eligibility criteria. Selected students will be invited for a counselling interview. students can choose any options for the interview process, which are one-on-one, online, or telephonic. Additionally, students must also appear for the entrance exam, personal interview, and group discussion as per the programme requirements.
3: Merit List/Cutoff/Counseling

Wait for the merit list to be announced by the college. The merit list will be based on the entrance exam scores and other criteria such cutoffs, academic performance, work experience, etc. Attend the counselling process and follow the guidelines provided by the college. The counselling process will involve document verification, seat allotment, fee payment, etc.
3: Seat offer

Once the application process and interviews are completed, the college admission official sends an admission offer to the students. Candidate must accept the offer by confirming it and paying the course fees.

faqs.question: How are BTech placements at University Visvesvaraya College of Engineering?
faqs.answer: The BTech placements at University Visvesvaraya College of Engineering (UVCE) are quite good. UVCE has a placement rate of 90%, which is one of the highest among engineering colleges in India. More than 98% of students in the ISE and CSE branches get placed in UVCE, and the highest salary package offered in the previous year was 40 LPA. admission_process.title: Aditya Institute of Technology and Management Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Aditya Institute of Technology and Management admissions 2025 are open. The college offers admission to full-time BTech, MTech and MBA courses. AITAM admissions 2025 are bothmeritandentrance-based. The college accepts state-level entrance exams such asEAMCET, ECET, ICET, GATEandPGCET.AITAMalso offers direct admission through Management quota. More details around Aditya Institute of Technology and Management admission are as follows:

AITAM admissions are merit and entrance-based. Candidates must fulfil the minimum eliigiblity for respectiveUG & PG courses. As per the selection criteria, the 70% of the seats are filled through entrance exam scores, while the remaining seats are filled through Management quota. Check below the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria for Aditya Institute of Technology and Management course admission:
70% seats-AP EAMCET
30% seats- Guidelines stipulated by APSCHE, Guntur
70% seats-APICET
30% seats- Through Management quota
70% seats-GATE/AP PGECET
30% seats- Through Management quota

Aditya Institute of Technology and Management admission process is both merit and entrance-based. Check out the detailed steps for admissions at Aditya Institute of Technology and Management in the section below:
Step 1: Application Process

For admission through Management quota, candidates must apply online on the official website of AITAM and fill the admission form. However, other candidtaes must apply for the respective entrance exams.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

AITAM admissions are conducted in two ways. A total of 70% seats are filled through scores obtained in the respective entrance exams. Further, the 30% seats are sanctioned through Management quota. For entrance-based admissions, aspirants need to qualify for entrance exams such as EAMCET, ICET, GATE and PGECET for respective UG & PG courses. Moreover, the college offers direct admissons as per the guidelines of Government of Andhra Pradesh (APSCHE)
Step 3: Final Admission
After the completion of all selection rounds, candidates must pay a certain fee to confirm their seats.

hostel.description: Separate hostel facility is available for both boys and girls.There are two boys hostels and two girls hostels. Each hostel is having a telephone, T.V., internet facility, sports items, water coolers, water heaters and well equipped mess facilities. All the hostels provide independent mess facility and serve both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food.

library.description: The central library has a wide collection of over 42,495 books, 3149 CD's and cassettes and several national and international periodicals.The library also provides access to a wide range of electronic and print resources.The books are classified and arranged according to the Dewey Decimal Classification (DDC) scheme and “Open Access” system is followed . reviews.review_heading: Review of AITAM College for the CSE course.
reviews.review_text: There are separate classes for every section in each course. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. We have a good central library which has a huge capacity for people. The food available in the canteen is good. I don't know much about the hostel because I am not a hosteller. We have a health centre on campus.

reviews.review_heading: You will definitely be satisfied.
reviews.review_text: Overall hostel is good, and food is also good. Wi-Fi is also available in the hostel. Some other facilities like washing machines, medical, etc., are available. A fully equipped library is available on the campus. Girls can access library till 7:00 PM, and for boys upto 9.00 PM.

reviews.review_heading: My college is good for studying, with infrastructure, and for maintaining hygiene.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for my course. Wi-Fi, classrooms, and the library are very good. Hostel facilities are better, and the quality of food in the mess and canteen is good. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: I feel very good about my college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good, not bad. The Wi-Fi on campus is okay, and labs’ equipment and data connection are good. The library is good in our college. The quality of facilities on campus is very good. Hostel maintenance and medical facilities are provided.

reviews.review_heading: My college is very good with facilities. It maintains hygiene.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for my course/ department are Wi-Fi and classrooms. Here, classrooms are very clean. The quality of facilities in my hostel is better. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is good. It also provides medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: My college infrastructure and atmosphere are very good. It is hygienic and clean.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are available. The quality of facilities in my hostel is better. The food in the mess and canteen is good. Medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with my college for now.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available at our college are very good. They will provide a good Wi-Fi connection, and the classrooms are good and clean. Coming to the library, there is a good one in our college. Our hostel, I think, is really good when compared to others. They will provide clean and hygienic goods for us.

reviews.review_heading: My college is overall really good.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities with library, Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms not bad, hostel facilities are good with Wi-Fi and rooms not bad, the campus has no fight issues as fines are imposed, and college has cafes and ice cream facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Know about that college AITAM.
reviews.review_text: Labs and infrastructure are very good. Wi-Fi is also good but sometimes it doesn't work for mobile. The labs are so good, and the equipments are also good. But in some labs, there is not sufficient equipments that will be upgraded. Canteen facility is also good. We have sports periods three times a week.

reviews.review_heading: Some faculty members are not bad. But the placements are average.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi has a low signal. Labs are pretty good, and classrooms are little bad. The library is too good. It has AC rooms, and they provide computers for doubt clarification. Medical facilities, sports, and games are pretty good, but the facilities are average.

reviews.review_heading: The review from the recent pass-out student in 2025.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well-designed, and the college environment is excellent. The college management has a separate department for new idea development to help students and upload the idea to the government website, like MSME, for funding.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Aditya Institute of Technology and Management.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the university plays a critical function in its development, as students are now focusing on the labs, lecture rooms, etc. It also has health and wellness facilities. It has excellent hostel facilities, offers top-notch food to students, and maintains a good environment.

reviews.review_heading: Joining in the college is good, don't expect big placements.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is good, with new blocks constructed featuring beautiful infrastructures. The library is excellent, offering an abundance of books perfect for studying. The quality of food in the canteen is poor sometimes, though it is good at other times, but sometimes it's the worst. Hostel facilities and hostel food are okay.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are available in our college. College has good internet and has seminar halls with AC. There is a separate library block in our college and have so many books. Those are very helpful for the students and staff to gain knowledge and have different types of text books. Food is good in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Aditya Institute of Technology and Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college plays a vital role in the development of the college, as students are now focusing on the labs, classrooms, etc. It also has health and wellness facilities. It has good hostel facilities. It provides top-notch food to students and also maintains a good environment.
